source.text: Ἐν οἷς ἐπισυναχθεισῶν τῶν μυριάδων τοῦ ὄχλου, ὥστε καταπατεῖν ἀλλήλους, ἤρξατο λέγειν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ πρῶτον· Προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης, ἥτις ἐστὶν ὑπόκρισις, τῶν Φαρισαίων.

records.literal_gloss: In which [time] having been gathered together the myriads of the crowd, so as to trample one another, he began to say to the disciples of him first, Take heed to yourselves of the leaven, which is hypocrisy, of the Pharisees.

en.L: Meanwhile, when the crowd had gathered by the tens of thousands, so that they were trampling one another, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} began to say to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples first, "Be wary of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
en.B: Meanwhile the crowd had grown to many thousands, so packed that people were stepping on one another. Jesus began to speak, first of all to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples: "Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees. I mean their hypocrisy.
en.R: By this time many thousands of people had come together. There were so many that they were stepping on each other. Jesus began to speak, first to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples. He said, "Be careful! Stay away from the yeast of the Pharisees. Their yeast is that they pretend to be good when they are not.

es.L: Entretanto, habiéndose reunido la multitud por decenas de miles, de modo que se pisoteaban unos a otros, comenzó a decir a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos primero: «{{plural_you:Estén en guardia|Estad en guardia}} ante la levadura de los fariseos, la cual es hipocresía.
es.B: Mientras tanto, la multitud había llegado a ser de muchos miles, tan apretada que se pisaban unos a otros. Jesús comenzó a hablar, primero que nada a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos: «{{plural_you:Cuídense|Cuidaos}} de la levadura de los fariseos. Me refiero a su hipocresía.
es.R: Para entonces se habían juntado muchos miles de personas. Eran tantas que se pisaban unos a otros. Jesús comenzó a hablar, primero a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos. Les dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado! {{plural_you:Aléjense|Alejaos}} de la levadura de los fariseos. Su levadura es que fingen ser buenos cuando no lo son.

fr.L: Sur ces entrefaites, la foule s’étant rassemblée par dizaines de milliers, au point qu’ils se piétinaient les uns les autres, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} commença à dire d’abord à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples : « Méfiez-vous du levain des Pharisiens, qui est l’hypocrisie.
fr.B: Pendant ce temps, la foule était devenue immense, des milliers de personnes, si serrées qu’on se marchait sur les pieds. Jésus se mit à parler, d’abord à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples : « Prenez garde au levain des Pharisiens, c’est-à-dire à leur hypocrisie.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, des milliers de personnes s’étaient rassemblées. Il y avait tant de monde qu’on se marchait sur les pieds. Jésus a commencé à parler, d’abord à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples. Il a dit : « Faites attention ! Méfiez-vous du levain des Pharisiens. Leur levain, c’est qu’ils font semblant d’être bons alors qu’ils ne le sont pas.

sw.L: Wakati huo, makutano walipokuwa wamekusanyika makumi ya maelfu, hata wakawa wakikanyagana, alianza kuwaambia wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwanza, "Jihadharini nafsi zenu na chachu ya Mafarisayo, iliyo unafiki.
sw.B: Wakati huo umati ulikuwa umefika maelfu mengi, nao ulikuwa umesongamana hata watu wakakanyagana. Yesu alianza kusema, kwanza kabisa na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}: "Jihadharini na chachu ya Mafarisayo, yaani unafiki wao.
sw.R: Kufikia wakati huo maelfu mengi ya watu walikuwa wamekusanyika. Walikuwa wengi sana hata wakakanyagana. Yesu alianza kusema, kwanza na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Aliwaambia, "Kuweni macho! Kaeni mbali na chachu ya Mafarisayo. Chachu yao ni kwamba wanajifanya kuwa wema kumbe sivyo.

vi.L: Trong lúc ấy, khi đoàn dân đông đến hàng vạn người tụ họp lại, đến nỗi giẫm đạp lên nhau, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt đầu nói trước hết với các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Hãy giữ mình khỏi men của người Pha-ri-si, tức là sự đạo đức giả.
vi.B: Trong lúc ấy, đoàn dân tụ tập đông đến hàng ngàn người, chen chúc đến nỗi giẫm lên nhau. Đức Giê-xu bắt đầu nói, trước hết với các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Hãy coi chừng men của người Pha-ri-si, tức là thói đạo đức giả của họ.
vi.R: Lúc ấy có hàng ngàn người tụ tập lại. Đông đến nỗi người này giẫm lên người kia. Đức Giê-xu bắt đầu nói, trước hết là với các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài nói: "Hãy cẩn thận! Hãy tránh xa men của người Pha-ri-si. Men ấy là thói giả vờ làm người tốt trong khi họ không tốt.

ko.L: 그러는 동안에 무리가 수만 명이나 모여들어 서로 밟힐 지경이 되었다. 그분이 그분의 제자들에게 먼저 말씀하기 시작하셨다. "바리새파 사람들의 누룩, 곧 위선을 조심하여라.
ko.B: 그러는 동안에 수천 명이나 되는 무리가 모여들어, 서로 발을 밟을 만큼 북적였다. 예수께서 먼저 제자들에게 말씀하기 시작하셨다. "바리새파 사람들의 누룩을 조심하여라. 그것은 그들의 위선이다.
ko.R: 그때쯤에는 수천 명이나 되는 사람들이 모여들었다. 사람이 너무 많아서 서로 발을 밟을 정도였다. 예수께서는 먼저 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "조심하여라! 바리새파 사람들의 누룩을 멀리하여라. 그들의 누룩은, 착하지 않으면서 착한 척하는 것이다.

decisions.choice: myriads: tens of thousands, a huge number
decisions.reason: The word means ten thousand, and in the plural a crowd too large to count. It is used here to show how many had come.

decisions.choice: first: goes with "to his disciples": Jesus spoke to his disciples first, before the crowd
alternatives: goes with "be on your guard": first of all, beware
decisions.reason: The word stands between the two phrases and can go with either. In 12:13-21 and 12:54 Jesus turns to the crowd, which suits a first word to the disciples.

decisions.choice: leaven: a lump of old, fermented dough kept back to make the next batch rise
decisions.reason: A little leaven worked through the whole batch (13:21; 1 Corinthians 5:6). It pictures something small and hidden that spreads through everything.

decisions.choice: hypocrisy: playing a part, showing a face that is not one's own
decisions.reason: The word comes from the stage, where an actor spoke from behind a mask. The Pharisees showed a religious face in public that did not match what was inside (11:39-44).

decisions.choice: the Pharisees: a Jewish movement devoted to keeping the law of Moses in every part of daily life
decisions.reason: They were respected teachers among the people, and Jesus had eaten at a Pharisee's table just before this (11:37-54).

decisions.choice: yeast (B, R); leaven (L)
decisions.reason: "Leaven" is no longer an everyday word. Balanced and Readable say "yeast", which does the same work.

decisions.choice: Their yeast is that they pretend to be good when they are not.
decisions.reason: Readable explains what hypocrisy is.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs on to 12:12
decisions.reason: Jesus' words in 12:1-12 are one speech.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:Estén en guardia|Estad en guardia}}; {{plural_you:Cuídense|Cuidaos}}
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to many, so every plural "you", pronoun or verb, is a reader setting: "ustedes" (Latin America, the default) or "vosotros" (Spain). English has no such choice. The same through the chapter; where Jesus speaks to one person (12:58-59), Spanish uses "tú", which has no setting.

decisions.choice: levadura at every level
decisions.reason: The English has "leaven" at Literal and "yeast" at Balanced and Readable. Spanish "levadura" is the ordinary word for both, the old fermented dough kept back (meaning decision m3) and bought yeast, so one word serves every level.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R); Jesus' sayings and the parables of 12:16-21 and 12:35-48 in the tenses of speech, the passé composé for past events, at every level
alternatives: the parables in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: As in John and Mark: the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative and suits a public reading; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and read in school today. Speech keeps its own tenses at every level, including the story of the rich fool told inside it ("la terre d’un homme riche a beaucoup rapporté"), as the style guide asks. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: le levain at every level
decisions.reason: English Balanced and Readable say "yeast" because "leaven" is no longer an everyday word. French "le levain" still is (bakers sell "pain au levain") and it is exactly the old fermented dough of m3, while "la levure" is modern baker's yeast. So French keeps one word at every level.

decisions.choice: wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}
decisions.reason: As in Luke 3, Swahili spans go only on free pronouns and possessives, never on verb prefixes (alianza, aliwaambia), which cannot take a capital; so Swahili has fewer spans than English through the chapter.

decisions.choice: chachu at every level
decisions.reason: The English has "leaven" at Literal and "yeast" at Balanced and Readable. "Chachu" is the leaven of old fermented dough kept back (meaning decision m3), the word Swahili uses for this picture; "hamira" is bought yeast.

decisions.choice: "men" for leaven at every level
decisions.reason: As in Mark 8:15: Vietnamese has one everyday word for leaven and yeast, so the English difference between Literal and the other levels does not arise.

decisions.choice: "sự đạo đức giả" (L); "thói đạo đức giả" (B); "thói giả vờ làm người tốt" (R); "các con" for the disciples (12:1-12, 12:22-53)
decisions.reason: "đạo đức giả" is the word settled for hypocrites in the Gospels (Matthew 6:2); Readable says what it is. Jesus speaks first to his disciples, so he calls them "các con".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Luke 12; the narrative honours Jesus with "께서" and -시- ("그분" at Literal), Jesus speaks in 해라체, and people speak to him in 합쇼체
alternatives: Korean spans for pronouns referring to Jesus
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (Korean style guide, sections 4 and 7).

decisions.choice: "누룩" at every level; "위선" (L, B), "착하지 않으면서 착한 척하는 것" (R)
decisions.reason: "누룩" is the word of the Korean Matthew 16:6 and is still understood; the English Balanced "yeast" has no better Korean counterpart.

source.text: οὐδὲν δὲ συγκεκαλυμμένον ἐστὶν ὃ οὐκ ἀποκαλυφθήσεται, καὶ κρυπτὸν ὃ οὐ γνωσθήσεται.

records.literal_gloss: Nothing now covered up is which not will be revealed, and hidden which not will be known.

en.L: And nothing is covered up that will not be uncovered, nor hidden that will not be known.
en.B: Everything that is covered up now will be uncovered, and every secret will come out.
en.R: Everything people try to cover up will be uncovered. Every secret will be made known.

es.L: Y no hay nada tapado que no vaya a ser destapado, ni escondido que no vaya a darse a conocer.
es.B: Todo lo que ahora está tapado será destapado, y todo secreto saldrá a la luz.
es.R: Todo lo que la gente trata de tapar será destapado. Todo secreto se llegará a saber.

fr.L: Or rien n’est voilé qui ne sera dévoilé, ni caché qui ne sera connu.
fr.B: Tout ce qui est couvert maintenant sera découvert, et tout secret finira par se savoir.
fr.R: Tout ce que les gens essaient de cacher sera découvert. Chaque secret sera connu.

sw.L: Wala hakuna kitu kilichofunikwa ambacho hakitafunuliwa, wala kilichofichwa ambacho hakitajulikana.
sw.B: Kila kitu kilichofunikwa sasa kitafunuliwa, na kila siri itajulikana wazi.
sw.R: Kila kitu ambacho watu hujaribu kukificha kitafunuliwa. Kila siri itajulikana.

vi.L: Không có gì bị che đậy mà sẽ không được bày tỏ ra, và [không có gì] bí mật mà sẽ không được biết đến.
vi.B: Mọi điều đang bị che đậy sẽ được bày tỏ ra, và mọi điều bí mật sẽ được mọi người biết.
vi.R: Mọi điều người ta cố che giấu rồi sẽ bị phơi bày. Mọi điều bí mật rồi sẽ được mọi người biết.

ko.L: 덮여 있는 것 가운데 드러나지 않을 것이 없고, 숨겨진 것 가운데 알려지지 않을 것이 없다.
ko.B: 지금 덮여 있는 것은 모두 드러나고, 숨겨진 것은 모두 알려질 것이다.
ko.R: 사람들이 숨기려고 하는 것은 모두 드러날 것이다. 비밀은 모두 알려지게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: covered up ... uncovered; hidden ... known: two matching sayings that say the same thing
decisions.reason: The two halves repeat each other, as Hebrew poetry does. Pretending cannot last, because in the end God will bring everything into the open (8:17).

decisions.choice: will be uncovered: at the judgment, by God
alternatives: found out by other people in this life
decisions.reason: The passive points to God. The verses that follow speak of God's judgment (12:4-5).

decisions.choice: Everything ... will be
alternatives: Nothing is ... that will not be
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the double negative into a plain statement with the same meaning.

source.text: ἀνθ’ ὧν ὅσα ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ εἴπατε ἐν τῷ φωτὶ ἀκουσθήσεται, καὶ ὃ πρὸς τὸ οὖς ἐλαλήσατε ἐν τοῖς ταμείοις κηρυχθήσεται ἐπὶ τῶν δωμάτων.

records.literal_gloss: Instead of which whatever in the darkness you have said in the light will be heard, and what to the ear you have spoken in the inner rooms will be proclaimed upon the housetops.

en.L: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light, and what you have spoken into the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed upon the housetops.
en.B: So anything you said in the dark will be heard in broad daylight. Anything you spoke into someone's ear in a back room will be announced from the tops of the houses.
en.R: So what you have said in the dark will be heard in the daylight. And what you have whispered behind closed doors will be shouted from the roofs for everyone to hear.

es.L: Por eso, todo lo que {{plural_you:dijeron|dijisteis}} en la oscuridad se oirá a la luz, y lo que {{plural_you:hablaron|hablasteis}} al oído en los cuartos interiores será pregonado sobre las azoteas.
es.B: Así que todo lo que {{plural_you:hayan dicho|hayáis dicho}} a oscuras se oirá a plena luz del día. Lo que {{plural_you:hayan dicho|hayáis dicho}} al oído de alguien en un cuarto apartado será anunciado desde lo alto de las casas.
es.R: Así que lo que {{plural_you:han dicho|habéis dicho}} en la oscuridad se oirá a la luz del día. Y lo que {{plural_you:han susurrado|habéis susurrado}} a puerta cerrada se gritará desde los techos para que todos lo oigan.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi tout ce que vous avez dit dans les ténèbres sera entendu dans la lumière, et ce que vous avez dit à l’oreille dans les chambres sera proclamé sur les toits.
fr.B: Ainsi, tout ce que vous avez dit dans l’obscurité sera entendu en plein jour. Ce que vous avez glissé à l’oreille de quelqu’un dans une pièce retirée sera annoncé du haut des toits.
fr.R: Ce que vous avez dit dans le noir sera donc entendu en plein jour. Et ce que vous avez chuchoté portes fermées sera crié sur les toits, pour que tout le monde l’entende.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, yote mliyoyasema gizani yatasikika katika nuru, na mliyoyanena sikioni katika vyumba vya ndani yatatangazwa juu ya mapaa.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo chochote mlichosema gizani kitasikika mchana kweupe. Chochote mlichomnong'oneza mtu katika chumba cha ndani kitatangazwa kutoka juu ya mapaa ya nyumba.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo mliyoyasema gizani yatasikika mchana. Na mliyoyanong'ona milango ikiwa imefungwa yatapigiwa kelele kutoka juu ya mapaa ili kila mtu ayasikie.

vi.L: Vì vậy, những gì các con đã nói trong bóng tối sẽ được nghe giữa ánh sáng, và điều các con đã nói vào tai trong phòng kín sẽ được rao lên trên mái nhà.
vi.B: Vậy những gì các con nói trong bóng tối sẽ được nghe giữa ban ngày, và những gì các con nói nhỏ bên tai ai trong phòng kín sẽ được rao lớn từ trên mái nhà.
vi.R: Vậy những gì các con nói trong bóng tối sẽ được nghe giữa ban ngày. Những gì các con thì thầm sau cánh cửa đóng kín sẽ được hô lớn từ trên mái nhà cho mọi người đều nghe.

ko.L: 그러므로 너희가 어둠 속에서 말한 것은 무엇이든지 빛 가운데서 들릴 것이고, 너희가 골방에서 귀에 대고 말한 것은 지붕 위에서 선포될 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 너희가 어두운 데서 한 말은 모두 밝은 데서 들릴 것이다. 너희가 골방에서 귓속말로 한 말은 지붕 위에서 큰 소리로 알려질 것이다.
ko.R: 그러니 너희가 어둠 속에서 한 말은 환한 데서 사람들이 듣게 될 것이다. 너희가 문을 닫고 속삭인 말은 모든 사람이 듣도록 지붕 위에서 외쳐질 것이다.

decisions.choice: therefore: because nothing stays hidden (12:2)
alternatives: because (giving a reason for what came before)
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean "because" or "so then". Here it draws out the result of 12:2.

decisions.choice: inner rooms; housetops: the most private place and the most public place
decisions.reason: The inner room was a room with no outside door or window, the place to hide or talk in secret. Roofs were flat, and from them a person could call out to the whole street.

decisions.choice: spoken into the ear: whispered
decisions.reason: To speak into someone's ear is to whisper.

decisions.choice: whispered behind closed doors
alternatives: spoken into the ear in the inner rooms
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the two pictures in everyday words.

decisions.choice: for everyone to hear
decisions.reason: Readable says why things were shouted from roofs.

decisions.choice: "trên mái nhà"
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 10:27: the flat roof was the most public place (meaning decision); "mái nhà" keeps the Bible's picture.

decisions.choice: "골방" (L, B), "문을 닫고" (R) for the inner rooms; "지붕 위" at every level
decisions.reason: The inner room is the most private place of the house and the flat roof the most public (meaning decision).

source.text: Λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν τοῖς φίλοις μου, μὴ φοβηθῆτε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀποκτεινόντων τὸ σῶμα καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα μὴ ἐχόντων περισσότερόν τι ποιῆσαι.

records.literal_gloss: I say now to you the friends of me, not you should fear because of those killing the body and after these things not having more anything to do.

en.L: And I say to you, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} friends, do not fear those who kill the body and after that have nothing more that they can do.
en.B: My friends, I tell you this: do not be afraid of people who can kill the body but then can do nothing further.
en.R: My friends, I tell you: do not be afraid of people. They can kill your body, but after that there is nothing more they can do to you.

es.L: Y a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} amigos, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: no {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo de los que matan el cuerpo y después de eso no tienen nada más que puedan hacer.
es.B: Amigos {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo esto: no {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo de los que pueden matar el cuerpo pero después ya no pueden hacer nada más.
es.R: Amigos {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: no {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo de la gente. Pueden matar {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo, pero después de eso ya no pueden {{plural_you:hacerles|haceros}} nada más.

fr.L: Et je vous dis, à vous, {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} amis : ne craignez pas ceux qui tuent le corps et qui, après cela, ne peuvent rien faire de plus.
fr.B: Mes amis, je vous le dis : n’ayez pas peur de ceux qui peuvent tuer le corps mais qui, ensuite, ne peuvent rien faire de plus.
fr.R: Mes amis, je vous le dis : n’ayez pas peur des gens. Ils peuvent tuer votre corps, mais après cela, ils ne peuvent plus rien vous faire.

sw.L: Nami nawaambia ninyi, rafiki {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, msiwaogope wale wanaoua mwili, na baada ya hayo hawana kitu zaidi cha kufanya.
sw.B: Rafiki {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, nawaambia hivi: msiwaogope watu wanaoweza kuua mwili, lakini baada ya hapo hawawezi kufanya kitu kingine.
sw.R: Rafiki {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, nawaambia: msiwaogope watu. Wanaweza kuua miili yenu, lakini baada ya hapo hawawezi kuwafanya kitu kingine.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, những bạn hữu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, đừng sợ những kẻ giết thân thể, và sau đó không thể làm gì hơn nữa.
vi.B: Hỡi các bạn hữu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con: đừng sợ những kẻ có thể giết thân thể nhưng sau đó không làm gì hơn được nữa.
vi.R: Các bạn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con: đừng sợ người ta. Họ có thể giết thân thể các con, nhưng sau đó họ không thể làm gì các con hơn được nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 내 친구들인 너희에게 내가 말한다. 몸은 죽여도 그 뒤에 더 이상 아무것도 할 수 없는 자들을 두려워하지 마라.
ko.B: 내 친구인 너희에게 내가 말한다. 몸은 죽일 수 있어도 그다음에는 더 아무것도 할 수 없는 사람들을 두려워하지 마라.
ko.R: 내 친구들아, 내가 너희에게 말한다. 사람들을 무서워하지 마라. 그들은 너희 몸을 죽일 수는 있다. 그러나 그 뒤에는 너희에게 더 아무것도 할 수 없다.

decisions.choice: my friends: those who belong to Jesus and share his trust
decisions.reason: Only here in the first three Gospels does Jesus call his disciples his friends (compare John 15:14-15). The word comes as he warns them about danger.

decisions.choice: kill the body: people can take this life, but not the life to come
alternatives: the body as opposed to an immortal soul as a teaching about human nature
decisions.reason: The point is how far human power reaches. Killing is the worst that people can do; it is not the end of a person before God (12:5).

decisions.choice: "bạn hữu của Ta" (L, B), "bạn của Ta" (R), with "các con" kept for "you"
decisions.reason: Jesus calls the disciples his friends (meaning decision), but the relation of teacher to disciples stays, so Vietnamese keeps "các con" beside the warmer word.

source.text: ὑποδείξω δὲ ὑμῖν τίνα φοβηθῆτε· φοβήθητε τὸν μετὰ τὸ ἀποκτεῖναι ἔχοντα ἐξουσίαν ἐμβαλεῖν εἰς τὴν γέενναν· ναί, λέγω ὑμῖν, τοῦτον φοβήθητε.

records.literal_gloss: I will show however to you whom you should fear: Fear the [one who] after the killing has authority to cast into the Gehenna. Yes, I say to you, him fear.

en.L: But I will show you whom you should fear: fear the one who, after the killing, has authority to throw into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: I will point out the one you should fear. Fear the one who, after the killing is done, has the right to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the one to fear.
en.R: I will tell you who you should be afraid of. Be afraid of God. After you die, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has the power to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the one to be afraid of.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:les|os}} mostraré a quién {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} temer: {{plural_you:teman|temed}} al que, después de matar, tiene autoridad para arrojar a la Gehena. Sí, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo, a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:teman|temed}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} indicaré a quién {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} temer. {{plural_you:Teman|Temed}} al que, una vez cumplida la muerte, tiene el derecho de {{plural_you:arrojarlos|arrojaros}} al infierno. Sí, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo, a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es a quien {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} temer.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} diré a quién {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} tener miedo. {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} miedo de Dios. Después de que {{plural_you:mueran|muráis}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tiene poder para {{plural_you:echarlos|echaros}} al infierno. Sí, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo, a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es a quien {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} tener miedo.

fr.L: Mais je vous montrerai qui craindre : craignez celui qui, après avoir fait mourir, a l’autorité de jeter dans la géhenne. Oui, je vous le dis, craignez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}.
fr.B: Je vais vous indiquer celui que vous devez craindre. Craignez celui qui, une fois la mort venue, a le droit de vous jeter en enfer. Oui, je vous le dis, c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qu’il faut craindre.
fr.R: Je vais vous dire de qui vous devez avoir peur. Ayez peur de Dieu. Après votre mort, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a le pouvoir de vous jeter en enfer. Oui, je vous le dis, c’est de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qu’il faut avoir peur.

sw.L: Lakini nitawaonyesha mnayepaswa kumwogopa: mwogopeni yule ambaye, baada ya kuua, ana mamlaka ya kutupa katika Gehena. Ndiyo, nawaambia, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mwogopeni.
sw.B: Nitawaonyesha mnayepaswa kumwogopa. Mwogopeni yule ambaye, baada ya kuua, ana haki ya kuwatupa jehanamu. Ndiyo, nawaambia, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye mnayepaswa kumwogopa.
sw.R: Nitawaambia mnayepaswa kumwogopa. Mwogopeni Mungu. Baada ya kufa kwenu, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ana uwezo wa kuwatupa jehanamu. Ndiyo, nawaambia, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye mnayepaswa kumwogopa.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chỉ cho các con phải sợ ai: hãy sợ Đấng, sau khi giết, có quyền ném vào Ghê-hen-na. Phải, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, hãy sợ Đấng ấy.
vi.B: Ta sẽ chỉ cho các con biết phải sợ ai. Hãy sợ Đấng sau khi giết rồi còn có quyền ném các con vào địa ngục. Phải, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, chính Đấng ấy là Đấng các con phải sợ.
vi.R: Ta sẽ cho các con biết các con nên sợ ai. Hãy kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời. Sau khi các con chết, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có quyền ném các con vào địa ngục. Phải, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng các con phải kính sợ.

ko.L: 그러나 너희가 누구를 두려워해야 할지 내가 너희에게 보여 주겠다. 죽인 뒤에 게헨나에 던져 넣을 권한을 가지신 분을 두려워하여라. 그렇다, 내가 너희에게 말한다. 그분을 두려워하여라.
ko.B: 너희가 누구를 두려워해야 할지 내가 알려 주겠다. 죽인 뒤에 너희를 지옥에 던져 넣을 권한이 있으신 분을 두려워하여라. 그렇다, 내가 너희에게 말한다. 바로 그분을 두려워하여라.
ko.R: 너희가 누구를 두려워해야 하는지 내가 말해 주겠다. 하나님을 두려워하여라. 하나님께서는 너희가 죽은 뒤에 너희를 지옥에 던져 넣으실 권한이 있으시다. 그렇다, 내가 너희에게 말한다. 바로 그분을 두려워하여라.

decisions.choice: the one who has authority to throw into Gehenna: God, the judge of all
decisions.reason: Only God has the right to judge after death. The next verses go straight on to God's care for the smallest bird (12:6-7), so the one to fear is the same God who cares. The devil is never said to have authority to throw anyone into Gehenna.

decisions.choice: Gehenna: the place of final judgment by fire
decisions.reason: Gehenna was the valley of Hinnom south of Jerusalem, where children had once been burned as sacrifices (Jeremiah 7:31-32). Its name became a name for the fire of God's final judgment (Matthew 5:22). It is not the same word as Hades, the place of the dead (10:15; 16:23).

decisions.choice: authority: the right and the power to act
decisions.reason: The word is the one used of the authority God gave Jesus and the Twelve (9:1). Here it is God's own right to judge.

decisions.choice: fear: reverent fear of God, the fear of one who will answer to him
decisions.reason: The same verb is used for fear of people (12:4) and fear of God. Fearing God is the beginning of wisdom (Proverbs 1:7), and it frees a person from the fear of people.

decisions.choice: hell (B, R); Gehenna (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the place name. Balanced and Readable use the word that names the place of final judgment, as Matthew 5:22 does.

decisions.choice: Be afraid of God.
decisions.reason: Readable names God, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: throw you into hell
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves the object unstated; Balanced and Readable supply "you" from the context.

decisions.choice: la Gehena (L); el infierno (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: Literal keeps the name of the place, Balanced and Readable say what it stands for, the place of final judgment (meaning decision m2), as the English says "hell".

decisions.choice: la géhenne (L); l’enfer (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms, following the English levels: Literal keeps the place name, Balanced and Readable say "l’enfer", the French word for the place of final judgment (m2).

decisions.choice: Gehena (L); jehanamu (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice: Literal keeps the name of the place, Balanced and Readable say "jehanamu", the Swahili word for the place of final judgment (meaning decision m2), as the English says "hell".

decisions.choice: mamlaka (L); haki (B)
decisions.reason: The right and the power to act (meaning decision m3). Literal says "mamlaka", the book-wide word; Balanced says "haki" (the right), as the English says "the right", and Readable "uwezo" (power), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Ghê-hen-na" (L); "địa ngục" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 9:43-47 and Matthew 10:28: Literal keeps the place name, the other levels the common Protestant word for the place of final judgment (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "Đấng", "Đấng ấy" (L, B) for "the one" and "him"
decisions.reason: The one to fear is God (meaning decision). As in Matthew 10:28, Vietnamese says "Đấng", always capitalised, where the English has "him" with the setting; Readable names God and then uses "Ngài".

decisions.choice: "게헨나" (L), "지옥" (B, R); the honorific for the one who has authority ("가지신 분", "그분")
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Matthew 5:22 and 10:28; the one to fear is God (meaning decision), so Korean honours him even before Readable names him.

source.text: οὐχὶ πέντε στρουθία πωλοῦνται ἀσσαρίων δύο;

records.literal_gloss: Not five sparrows are sold for assaria two?

en.L: Are not five sparrows sold for two assaria?
en.B: You can buy five sparrows for {{units:two pennies|two assaria}}, can you not?
en.R: Five sparrows are sold for only {{units:two pennies|two assaria}}.

es.L: ¿No se venden cinco gorriones por dos ases?
es.B: Cinco gorriones se compran por {{units:más o menos una hora de salario|dos ases}}, ¿no es así?
es.R: Cinco gorriones se venden por solo {{units:lo que se gana en una hora de trabajo|dos ases}}.

fr.L: Cinq moineaux ne se vendent-ils pas deux as ?
fr.B: On peut acheter cinq moineaux pour {{units:deux centimes|deux as}}, n’est-ce pas ?
fr.R: On vend cinq moineaux pour seulement {{units:deux centimes|deux as}}.

sw.L: Je, shomoro watano hawauzwi kwa asarioni mbili?
sw.B: Mnaweza kununua shomoro watano kwa {{units:mshahara wa saa moja hivi|asarioni mbili}}, sivyo?
sw.R: Shomoro watano huuzwa kwa {{units:mshahara wa saa moja tu|asarioni mbili tu}}.

vi.L: Chẳng phải năm con chim sẻ bán được hai đồng át-xa-ri-ôn sao?
vi.B: Năm con chim sẻ chỉ bán được {{units:hai đồng xu nhỏ|hai đồng át-xa-ri-ôn}}, phải không?
vi.R: Năm con chim sẻ chỉ bán được {{units:hai đồng xu nhỏ|hai đồng át-xa-ri-ôn}}.

ko.L: 참새 다섯 마리가 두 앗사리온에 팔리지 않느냐?
ko.B: 참새 다섯 마리가 {{units:두 푼|두 앗사리온}}에 팔리지 않느냐?
ko.R: 참새 다섯 마리는 {{units:동전 두 닢|두 앗사리온}}에 팔린다.

decisions.choice: sparrows: small birds sold cheaply for food
decisions.reason: Small birds were sold in the market as food for the poor. They were among the cheapest things one could buy.

decisions.choice: assarion: a small copper coin
decisions.reason: An assarion was a Roman copper coin worth a sixteenth of a denarius, the day's wage of a laborer (Matthew 20:2). Two of them bought five sparrows; in Matthew 10:29 one buys two, so a fifth bird was thrown in for the larger purchase.

decisions.choice: {{units:two pennies|two assaria}}
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use a modern small coin by default, with the original coin as the alternative, as Matthew 5:26 does. Literal keeps the original coin.

decisions.choice: a statement (R); a statement with a question tag (B)
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer yes; Readable gives the answer, and Balanced asks for agreement in a natural way.

decisions.choice: dos ases (L); {{units:más o menos una hora de salario|dos ases}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The assarion was a small copper coin (meaning decision m2), a sixteenth of a day's wage, so two were about an hour's pay. As with other coins (Matthew 10:29, John 6:7), the modern reading gives it as wages, where the English gives "two pennies". "As" is the Spanish name of the Roman coin.

decisions.choice: {{units:deux centimes|deux as}} (B, R); deux as (L)
decisions.reason: As in English, Balanced and Readable give a modern small coin by default and the original coin as the alternative; French uses the euro cent, the coin French readers think of as almost worthless, where English uses pennies. "As" is the usual French name of the Roman coin (assarion). The same holds for "centime" against "lepte" in 12:59.

decisions.choice: asarioni mbili (L); {{units:mshahara wa saa moja hivi|asarioni mbili}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The assarion was a small copper coin (meaning decision m2), a sixteenth of a day's wage, so two were about an hour's pay. As with other coins (Matthew 10:29, John 6:7), the modern reading gives it as wages, where the English gives "two pennies".

decisions.choice: "hai đồng át-xa-ri-ôn" (L, and the alternative in B, R); "hai đồng xu nhỏ" as the B, R default
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 10:29: Vietnamese has no coin like the English "penny"; "đồng xu nhỏ" says what matters, that the birds were almost worthless (meaning decision). The alternative gives the Roman coin in Vietnamese syllables.

decisions.choice: {{units:두 푼|두 앗사리온}} (B), {{units:동전 두 닢|두 앗사리온}} (R); Literal keeps "앗사리온"
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Matthew 10:29: a very small sum by default, the coin itself as the alternative; the English default "pennies" has no place in Korean.

source.text: καὶ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔστιν ἐπιλελησμένον ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And one of them not is forgotten before the God.

en.L: And not one of them is forgotten before God.
en.B: Yet God does not forget a single one of them.
en.R: But God does not forget even one of them.

es.L: Y ni uno de ellos está olvidado delante de Dios.
es.B: Y, sin embargo, Dios no se olvida de ninguno de ellos.
es.R: Pero Dios no se olvida ni siquiera de uno de ellos.

fr.L: Et pas un d’entre eux n’est oublié devant Dieu.
fr.B: Pourtant Dieu n’en oublie pas un seul.
fr.R: Mais Dieu n’oublie pas même un seul d’entre eux.

sw.L: Na hata mmoja wao hajasahauliwa mbele za Mungu.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, Mungu hamsahau hata mmoja wao.
sw.R: Lakini Mungu hamsahau hata mmoja wao.

vi.L: Và không một con nào trong chúng bị quên trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Thế mà Đức Chúa Trời không quên một con nào trong số đó.
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời không quên dù chỉ một con.

ko.L: 그러나 그것들 가운데 하나도 하나님 앞에서 잊히지 않는다.
ko.B: 그러나 하나님께서는 그 가운데 한 마리도 잊지 않으신다.
ko.R: 그러나 하나님께서는 그 가운데 한 마리도 잊지 않으신다.

decisions.choice: forgotten before God: overlooked by God
alternatives: forgotten in God's presence by others
decisions.reason: "Before God" is a reverent way of saying "by God". God keeps even the cheapest bird in mind.

decisions.choice: God does not forget
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make God the subject, as the meaning decision explains.

source.text: ἀλλὰ καὶ αἱ τρίχες τῆς κεφαλῆς ὑμῶν πᾶσαι ἠρίθμηνται· μὴ φοβεῖσθε· πολλῶν στρουθίων διαφέρετε.

records.literal_gloss: But even the hairs of the head of you all have been numbered. Not fear; than many sparrows you are more valuable.

en.L: But even the hairs of your head have all been counted. Do not fear; you are worth more than many sparrows.
en.B: Why, every hair on your head has been counted. So do not be afraid. You matter more than a great many sparrows.
en.R: God even knows how many hairs are on your head. So do not be afraid. You are worth much more to God than many sparrows.

es.L: Pero incluso los cabellos de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} cabeza están todos contados. No {{plural_you:teman|temáis}}; {{plural_you:valen|valéis}} más que muchos gorriones.
es.B: Es más, cada cabello de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} cabeza ha sido contado. Así que no {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo. {{plural_you:Ustedes valen|Vosotros valéis}} más que un montón de gorriones.
es.R: Dios sabe incluso cuántos cabellos {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} en la cabeza. Así que no {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo. Para Dios, {{plural_you:ustedes valen|vosotros valéis}} mucho más que muchos gorriones.

fr.L: Mais même les cheveux de votre tête ont tous été comptés. Ne craignez pas : vous valez plus que beaucoup de moineaux.
fr.B: Bien plus, chaque cheveu de votre tête a été compté. N’ayez donc pas peur. Vous comptez plus qu’une multitude de moineaux.
fr.R: Dieu sait même combien vous avez de cheveux sur la tête. Alors n’ayez pas peur. Pour Dieu, vous valez beaucoup plus que beaucoup de moineaux.

sw.L: Lakini hata nywele za kichwa chenu zote zimehesabiwa. Msiogope; mnawapita shomoro wengi kwa thamani.
sw.B: Naam, kila unywele wa kichwa chenu umehesabiwa. Kwa hiyo msiogope. Ninyi ni wa thamani kuliko shomoro wengi mno.
sw.R: Mungu anajua hata idadi ya nywele zilizo vichwani mwenu. Kwa hiyo msiogope. Mbele za Mungu mna thamani kubwa kuliko shomoro wengi.

vi.L: Nhưng ngay cả tóc trên đầu các con cũng đã được đếm hết rồi. Đừng sợ; các con quý hơn nhiều chim sẻ.
vi.B: Ngay cả từng sợi tóc trên đầu các con cũng đã được đếm cả rồi. Vậy đừng sợ. Các con quý hơn cả một đàn chim sẻ.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời còn biết trên đầu các con có bao nhiêu sợi tóc. Vậy đừng sợ. Đối với Đức Chúa Trời, các con quý hơn nhiều con chim sẻ.

ko.L: 그러나 너희 머리카락까지도 모두 세어져 있다. 두려워하지 마라. 너희는 많은 참새보다 더 귀하다.
ko.B: 너희 머리카락까지도 하나하나 다 세어져 있다. 그러니 두려워하지 마라. 너희는 참새 떼보다 훨씬 더 귀하다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 너희 머리카락이 몇 개인지까지 다 알고 계신다. 그러니 무서워하지 마라. 하나님께는 너희가 참새 여러 마리보다 훨씬 더 귀하다.

decisions.choice: have been counted: counted by God, and the count stands
decisions.reason: The passive leaves God as the one who counts, and the perfect tense says that the count is already made. God's care reaches the smallest detail (21:18; 1 Samuel 14:45).

decisions.choice: you are worth more than many sparrows: an argument from the lesser to the greater
decisions.reason: If God does not forget a sparrow, he will not forget his own people (12:24).

decisions.choice: God even knows; worth much more to God
alternatives: have all been counted; you are worth more
decisions.reason: Readable names God, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: Why,
decisions.reason: Balanced shows the surprise of "even" with a word that starts the sentence.

decisions.choice: Bien plus,
decisions.reason: English Balanced marks the surprise of "even" with "Why,". French has no such opening word; "Bien plus" carries the step up from the sparrows to the readers' own hairs.

source.text: Λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν, πᾶς ὃς ἂν ὁμολογήσῃ ἐν ἐμοὶ ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων, καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὁμολογήσει ἐν αὐτῷ ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀγγέλων τοῦ θεοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: I say now to you, everyone who would confess in me before the men, also the Son of Man will confess in him before the angels of the God.

en.L: And I tell you, everyone who acknowledges {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} before {{gender:people|men}}, the Son of Man also will acknowledge {{gender:that person|him}} before the angels of God.
en.B: I tell you, if anyone openly stands with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in front of others, the Son of Man will stand with {{gender:that person|him}} in front of God's angels.
en.R: I tell you, if you say in front of other people that you belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, then the Son of Man will say in front of God's angels that you belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: todo el que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} reconozca delante de {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}, también el Hijo del Hombre lo reconocerá delante de los ángeles de Dios.
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que si alguien se pone de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lado abiertamente delante de los demás, el Hijo del Hombre se pondrá de su lado delante de los ángeles de Dios.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que si alguien dice delante de otras personas que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenece, el Hijo del Hombre dirá delante de los ángeles de Dios que esa persona {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenece.

fr.L: Et je vous dis : quiconque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} reconnaîtra devant les {{gender:gens|hommes}}, le Fils de l’homme aussi le reconnaîtra devant les anges de Dieu.
fr.B: Je vous le dis : si quelqu’un prend ouvertement parti pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} devant les autres, le Fils de l’homme prendra parti pour lui devant les anges de Dieu.
fr.R: Je vous le dis : si vous dites devant les autres que vous êtes à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, alors le Fils de l’homme dira devant les anges de Dieu que vous êtes à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Nawaambia, kila mtu atakayenitambua mbele ya watu, Mwana wa Adamu {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atamtambua mbele ya malaika wa Mungu.
sw.B: Nawaambia, mtu yeyote atakayesimama upande {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} waziwazi mbele ya wengine, Mwana wa Adamu atasimama upande wake mbele ya malaika wa Mungu.
sw.R: Nawaambia, mtu akisema mbele ya watu wengine kwamba yeye ni {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Mwana wa Adamu atasema mbele ya malaika wa Mungu kwamba mtu huyo ni {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, hễ ai xưng nhận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trước mặt người ta, thì Con Người cũng sẽ xưng nhận người ấy trước mặt các thiên sứ của Đức Chúa Trời;
vi.B: Ta nói với các con, ai công khai xưng nhận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trước mặt người ta, thì Con Người cũng sẽ xưng nhận người ấy trước mặt các thiên sứ của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Ta nói với các con, ai dám nói công khai trước mặt người khác rằng mình thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì Con Người cũng sẽ nói trước mặt các thiên sứ của Đức Chúa Trời rằng người ấy thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 누구든지 사람들 앞에서 나를 시인하면, 인자도 하나님의 천사들 앞에서 그 사람을 시인할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 누구든지 사람들 앞에서 나를 떳떳이 시인하면, 인자도 하나님의 천사들 앞에서 그 사람을 시인할 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 사람들 앞에서 내 사람이라고 떳떳이 말하면, 인자, 곧 사람의 아들도 하나님의 천사들 앞에서 너희가 자기 사람이라고 말할 것이다.

decisions.choice: acknowledge: say openly that one belongs to someone
decisions.reason: The verb means to say the same thing, to agree openly. To acknowledge Jesus is to say in public that one is his. The Son of Man will do the same for that person at the judgment.

decisions.choice: acknowledge in me ... in him: acknowledge me ... him
decisions.reason: The words "in me" and "in him" follow an Aramaic way of speaking and add no separate meaning.

decisions.choice: the Son of Man: Jesus speaking of himself as the one who will come as judge
decisions.reason: Jesus uses the title for himself throughout Luke (5:24; 9:22, 26). Here, as in 9:26, he will be the one who speaks for his people before God (Daniel 7:13-14).

decisions.choice: people: human beings, men and women
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general.

decisions.choice: {{gender:people|men}}; {{gender:that person|him}}
decisions.reason: The saying is for everyone. The inclusive form is the default, with the traditional form as the alternative.

decisions.choice: say ... that you belong to me
decisions.reason: Readable says what acknowledging Jesus means and speaks to the reader directly.

decisions.choice: {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}; lo, with no span
decisions.reason: "Los hombres" means people in general (meaning decision m4), so Literal has the same gender span as the English. Spanish "lo" for "everyone who" is the ordinary generic form and has no inclusive alternative, so it takes none, as in Matthew 10:32.

decisions.choice: alguien ... esa persona, in the third person
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "if you say", a generic "you". Spanish keeps the third person of the Greek ("everyone who"), which says the same and does not suggest that Jesus means only the disciples in front of him.

decisions.choice: {{gender:gens|hommes}} on the noun (L); "quiconque … le", "quelqu’un … lui" with no span (L, B); the same in 12:10, 12:21, 12:25 and 12:58
decisions.reason: The setting goes on the noun French has to choose ("devant les gens" / "devant les hommes"). The pronouns that refer back to "quiconque" or "quelqu’un" are ordinary generic French and take no span, as the style guide asks, so French has no span where English has {{gender:that person|him}}.

decisions.choice: kutambua (to own, acknowledge as one's own)
decisions.reason: To say openly that one belongs to someone (meaning decision m1), as in Matthew 10:32. "Kutambua" is to recognise and own someone; "kukiri" is more often to admit a fact. "Watu" already includes men and women, so there is no gender span.

decisions.choice: Mwana wa Adamu
decisions.reason: The book-wide title (meaning decision m3), the settled Swahili form; "Adamu" also means humankind. It is never under the gender setting.

decisions.choice: "xưng nhận" (L, B); "nói ... rằng mình thuộc về Ta" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 10:32: to acknowledge is to say openly that one belongs to Jesus (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "người ta" and "người ấy" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Both words already include men and women, so the English spans have no Vietnamese counterpart; the same in 12:9-10, 12:21, 12:25, 12:36, 12:48 and 12:58.

decisions.choice: "시인하다" (L, B); "내 사람이라고 말하다" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Matthew 10:32; "고백하다" would suggest confessing a sin.

decisions.choice: "사람들" and "그 사람" with no gender span, where the English has spans (L, B); also 12:9-10 and 12:21
alternatives: a gender span with "남자" as the alternative
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" already includes men and women.

decisions.choice: "인자" at every level, with "곧 사람의 아들" once (R) in this chapter
decisions.reason: The title settled for the Korean Gospels.

source.text: ὁ δὲ ἀρνησάμενός με ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἀπαρνηθήσεται ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀγγέλων τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] now having denied me before the men will be denied before the angels of the God.

en.L: But the one who denies {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} before {{gender:people|men}} will be denied before the angels of God.
en.B: But whoever denies knowing {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in front of others will be denied in front of God's angels.
en.R: But if you say in front of other people that you do not know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, then in front of God's angels it will be said that you do not belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Pero el que reniegue de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} delante de {{gender:la gente|los hombres}} será negado delante de los ángeles de Dios.
es.B: Pero quien niegue conocerme delante de los demás será negado delante de los ángeles de Dios.
es.R: Pero si alguien dice delante de otras personas que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conoce, delante de los ángeles de Dios se dirá que esa persona no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenece.

fr.L: Mais celui qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}aura renié devant les {{gender:gens|hommes}} sera renié devant les anges de Dieu.
fr.B: Mais celui qui aura nié {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaître devant les autres sera renié devant les anges de Dieu.
fr.R: Mais si vous dites devant les autres que vous ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaissez pas, alors, devant les anges de Dieu, on dira que vous n’êtes pas à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Lakini yule atakayenikataa mbele ya watu atakataliwa mbele ya malaika wa Mungu.
sw.B: Lakini yeyote atakayekana kunijua mbele ya wengine atakataliwa mbele ya malaika wa Mungu.
sw.R: Lakini mtu akisema mbele ya watu wengine kwamba hanijui, basi mbele ya malaika wa Mungu itasemwa kwamba mtu huyo si {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.

vi.L: Nhưng ai chối {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trước mặt người ta thì sẽ bị chối trước mặt các thiên sứ của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Nhưng ai chối bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trước mặt người ta thì sẽ bị chối bỏ trước mặt các thiên sứ của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Nhưng ai nói trước mặt người khác rằng mình không biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì trước mặt các thiên sứ của Đức Chúa Trời, người ấy sẽ bị tuyên bố là không thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그러나 사람들 앞에서 나를 부인하는 사람은 하나님의 천사들 앞에서 부인당할 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 사람들 앞에서 나를 모른다고 부인하는 사람은 하나님의 천사들 앞에서 부인당할 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 너희가 사람들 앞에서 나를 모른다고 말하면, 하나님의 천사들 앞에서도 너희가 내 사람이 아니라는 말을 듣게 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: deny: disown, refuse to be known as someone's
decisions.reason: Peter later does this, saying three times that he does not know Jesus (22:57-61).

decisions.choice: will be denied: by the Son of Man
decisions.reason: The passive matches 12:8: the Son of Man will refuse to own that person, as 9:26 says.

decisions.choice: {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: As in 12:8.

decisions.choice: say that you do not know me; it will be said that you do not belong to me
decisions.reason: Readable explains what denying Jesus means, as in 22:57.

decisions.choice: renegar de ... ser negado
decisions.reason: To disown someone, to refuse to be known as theirs (meaning decision m1). "Renegar de" says that plainly, as in Matthew 10:33; the passive has no such form, so "será negado" follows.

decisions.choice: kukataa ... kukataliwa
decisions.reason: To disown, to refuse to be known as someone's (meaning decision m1), as in Matthew 10:33. "Kukataa" is to reject or disown; Balanced says "kukana kunijua" (deny knowing me), where "kukana" fits, as the English says "denies knowing".

decisions.choice: "chối" (L); "chối bỏ" (B)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 10:33: to deny is to disown (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "부인하다" (L, B); "모른다고 말하다" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Matthew 10:33.

source.text: καὶ πᾶς ὃς ἐρεῖ λόγον εἰς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, ἀφεθήσεται αὐτῷ τῷ δὲ εἰς τὸ ἅγιον πνεῦμα βλασφημήσαντι οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται.

records.literal_gloss: And everyone who will speak a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; the [one] however against the Holy Spirit having blasphemed not will be forgiven.

en.L: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven {{gender:them|him}}; but the one who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
en.B: Anyone who says something against the Son of Man will be forgiven. But anyone who speaks evil against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
en.R: Anyone who speaks against the Son of Man can be forgiven. But anyone who insults the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

es.L: Y a todo el que diga una palabra contra el Hijo del Hombre, se le perdonará; pero al que blasfeme contra el Espíritu Santo no se le perdonará.
es.B: A quien diga algo contra el Hijo del Hombre se le perdonará. Pero a quien injurie al Espíritu Santo no se le perdonará.
es.R: Quien hable contra el Hijo del Hombre puede ser perdonado. Pero quien insulte al Espíritu Santo no será perdonado.

fr.L: Et quiconque dira une parole contre le Fils de l’homme, il lui sera pardonné ; mais à celui qui aura blasphémé contre l’Esprit Saint, il ne sera pas pardonné.
fr.B: Celui qui dira quelque chose contre le Fils de l’homme sera pardonné. Mais celui qui dira du mal de l’Esprit Saint ne sera pas pardonné.
fr.R: Celui qui parle contre le Fils de l’homme peut être pardonné. Mais celui qui insulte l’Esprit Saint ne sera pas pardonné.

sw.L: Na kila atakayesema neno dhidi ya Mwana wa Adamu, atasamehewa; lakini yule aliyemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa.
sw.B: Yeyote atakayesema jambo dhidi ya Mwana wa Adamu atasamehewa. Lakini yeyote atakayemkufuru Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa.
sw.R: Mtu anayesema vibaya juu ya Mwana wa Adamu anaweza kusamehewa. Lakini mtu anayemtukana Roho Mtakatifu hatasamehewa.

vi.L: Và hễ ai nói một lời nghịch cùng Con Người thì sẽ được tha; nhưng ai phạm thượng đến Đức Thánh Linh thì sẽ không được tha.
vi.B: Ai nói điều gì nghịch cùng Con Người thì có thể được tha. Nhưng ai nói phạm thượng đến Đức Thánh Linh thì sẽ không được tha.
vi.R: Ai nói điều xấu nghịch cùng Con Người thì có thể được tha. Nhưng ai nói xúc phạm Đức Thánh Linh thì sẽ không được tha.

ko.L: 그리고 누구든지 인자를 거슬러 말을 하는 사람은 용서받을 것이다. 그러나 성령을 모독하는 사람은 용서받지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 누구든지 인자를 거슬러 말하는 사람은 용서받을 수 있다. 그러나 성령을 모독하는 사람은 용서받지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 인자를 나쁘게 말하는 사람은 용서받을 수 있다. 그러나 성령을 욕되게 하는 사람은 용서받지 못할 것이다.

decisions.choice: blasphemes against the Holy Spirit: sets oneself against the Spirit's witness to Jesus and refuses God's forgiveness
decisions.reason: In Mark 3:28-30 the saying answers people who called the Spirit's work in Jesus the work of an unclean spirit. Here it stands between denying Jesus (12:9) and the Spirit's help to those on trial (12:12). Speaking against the Son of Man, as Peter later did, can be forgiven; turning against the Spirit who calls people to repent shuts out the forgiveness he offers.

decisions.choice: blaspheme: speak evil of, insult
decisions.reason: The verb means to speak in a way that dishonors someone, here God the Holy Spirit.

decisions.choice: {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: The saying covers everyone; the inclusive form is the default.

decisions.choice: speaks evil against (B); insults (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the church word "blaspheme" means.

decisions.choice: blasfemar contra (L); injuriar (B); insultar (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to speak evil of, to insult (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps "blasfemar", the word for this against God; Balanced and Readable say it in everyday words, as the English does. Spanish needs no pronoun for the person forgiven, so the English gender span has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: l’Esprit Saint
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form, as in John, Mark and Hebrews.

decisions.choice: kukufuru (L, B); kumtukana (R)
decisions.reason: To speak evil of, to insult (meaning decision m2). "Kukufuru" is the Swahili word for speaking evil against God, plain enough for Balanced; Readable says "kumtukana" (to insult), as the English Readable says "insults".

decisions.choice: "phạm thượng" (L, B); "nói xúc phạm" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 3:29 and Matthew 12:31-32: "phạm thượng" is the standard word for blasphemy (meaning decision); Readable uses the everyday words.

decisions.choice: "모독하다" (L, B); "욕되게 하다" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Matthew 12:31-32.

source.text: ὅταν δὲ εἰσφέρωσιν ὑμᾶς ἐπὶ τὰς συναγωγὰς καὶ τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς ἐξουσίας, μὴ μεριμνήσητε πῶς ἢ τί ἀπολογήσησθε ἢ τί εἴπητε·

records.literal_gloss: When then they bring in you before the synagogues and the rulers and the authorities, not be anxious how or what you should reply in defense or what you should say.

en.L: And when they bring you before the synagogues and the rulers and the authorities, do not be anxious about how or what you should answer in your defense, or what you should say.
en.B: People will bring you before synagogues, rulers and officials. When they do, do not worry over how to answer the charges or what words to use.
en.R: People will take you to the synagogues and to rulers and officials to be judged. When that happens, do not worry about how to defend yourselves or about what to say.

es.L: Y cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} lleven ante las sinagogas y los gobernantes y las autoridades, no {{plural_you:se inquieten|os inquietéis}} por cómo o qué {{plural_you:responderán|responderéis}} en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} defensa, o qué {{plural_you:dirán|diréis}};
es.B: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} llevarán ante las sinagogas, los gobernantes y las autoridades. Cuando eso pase, no {{plural_you:se preocupen|os preocupéis}} por cómo responder a las acusaciones ni por qué palabras usar.
es.R: La gente {{plural_you:los|os}} llevará a las sinagogas y ante gobernantes y autoridades para {{plural_you:juzgarlos|juzgaros}}. Cuando eso pase, no {{plural_you:se preocupen|os preocupéis}} por cómo {{plural_you:defenderse|defenderos}} ni por lo que {{plural_you:van|vais}} a decir.

fr.L: Et quand on vous mènera devant les synagogues, les magistrats et les autorités, ne soyez pas en souci de la manière ou des mots pour vous défendre, ni de ce que vous direz.
fr.B: On vous fera comparaître devant les synagogues, les dirigeants et les autorités. Quand cela arrivera, ne vous inquiétez pas de la façon de répondre aux accusations ni des mots à employer.
fr.R: On vous emmènera dans les synagogues, devant les chefs et les autorités, pour vous juger. Quand cela arrivera, ne vous inquiétez pas de la manière de vous défendre ni de ce que vous direz.

sw.L: Na watakapowaleta mbele ya masinagogi, na watawala, na wenye mamlaka, msiwe na wasiwasi jinsi au nini mtakachojibu katika kujitetea, au nini mtakachosema;
sw.B: Watu watawapeleka mbele ya masinagogi, watawala na maafisa. Wakifanya hivyo, msiwe na wasiwasi juu ya jinsi ya kujibu mashtaka wala maneno ya kutumia.
sw.R: Watu watawapeleka kwenye masinagogi na mbele ya watawala na maafisa ili mhukumiwe. Hilo likitokea, msiwe na wasiwasi juu ya jinsi ya kujitetea wala juu ya mtakachosema.

vi.L: Khi người ta đem các con đến trước các nhà hội, các nhà cầm quyền và các bậc có thẩm quyền, đừng lo lắng về việc phải tự biện hộ thế nào hay [biện hộ] điều gì, hoặc phải nói gì;
vi.B: Khi người ta đưa các con ra trước các nhà hội, các nhà cầm quyền và các quan chức, đừng lo lắng phải tự bào chữa thế nào hay phải nói những lời gì.
vi.R: Người ta sẽ đưa các con đến các nhà hội, đến trước các nhà cầm quyền và các quan chức để xét xử. Khi điều đó xảy ra, đừng lo lắng không biết phải tự bào chữa thế nào hay phải nói gì.

ko.L: 그리고 사람들이 너희를 회당들과 통치자들과 권세자들 앞으로 끌고 갈 때에, 어떻게 또는 무엇으로 변호할지, 또는 무엇을 말할지 염려하지 마라.
ko.B: 사람들이 너희를 회당이나 통치자나 관리들 앞으로 끌고 가거든, 어떻게 변호할지, 무슨 말을 할지 걱정하지 마라.
ko.R: 사람들이 너희를 재판하려고 회당이나 통치자나 관리들 앞으로 끌고 갈 것이다. 그때에 너희는 어떻게 변호할지, 무슨 말을 해야 할지 걱정하지 마라.

decisions.choice: synagogues, rulers, authorities: Jewish and Gentile courts
decisions.reason: Synagogue leaders could judge and punish their members. Rulers and authorities are the officials of cities and of Rome. Acts tells of the apostles before both (Acts 4:5-7; 16:19-22; 24:10).

decisions.choice: be anxious: worry, be troubled in mind
decisions.reason: Jesus forbids fretting, not thinking. The Spirit will give the words (12:12).

decisions.choice: answer in your defense: make a defense in court
decisions.reason: The verb is the legal term for a defendant's reply to a charge (21:14).

decisions.choice: worry (B, R); be anxious (L)
decisions.reason: The verb means to be anxious or troubled in mind. Literal keeps "be anxious"; Balanced and Readable use the everyday word, as Matthew 6:25 does.

decisions.choice: to be judged
decisions.reason: Readable says why they are brought before these people.

decisions.choice: inquietarse (L); preocuparse (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English and Matthew 6:25-34: Literal says "inquietarse", to be anxious (meaning decision m2), and Balanced and Readable the everyday "preocuparse". Each level keeps its word for this verb through the chapter (12:22, 12:25-26).

decisions.choice: être en souci (L); s’inquiéter (B, R); the same in 12:22, 12:25 and 12:26
decisions.reason: As in English, Literal keeps a phrase for being troubled in mind and Balanced and Readable use the everyday verb. "Être anxieux" sounds clinical in French; "être en souci" is the older, plain expression.

decisions.choice: kuwa na wasiwasi at every level
decisions.reason: The English says "be anxious" at Literal and "worry" at Balanced and Readable (meaning decision m2). Swahili "kuwa na wasiwasi" is both, so every level keeps it for this verb through the chapter (12:22, 12:25-26), as in Matthew 6:25-34.

decisions.choice: "lo lắng" at every level (12:11, 12:22-29)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 6:25-34: "lo lắng" is the everyday word for worry and serves all three levels, so the English difference between "be anxious" and "worry" does not arise.

decisions.choice: "염려하다" (L), "걱정하다" (B, R) for merimnaō, here and in 12:22-26
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Matthew 6:25-34.

source.text: τὸ γὰρ ἅγιον πνεῦμα διδάξει ὑμᾶς ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἃ δεῖ εἰπεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: The for Holy Spirit will teach you in the same the hour what it behooves to say.

en.L: For the Holy Spirit will teach you in that very hour what you must say."
en.B: When the moment comes, the Holy Spirit will teach you what you need to say."
en.R: The Holy Spirit will show you then and there what you ought to say."

es.L: Porque el Espíritu Santo {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñará en esa misma hora lo que es necesario decir».
es.B: Cuando llegue el momento, el Espíritu Santo {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñará lo que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} que decir».
es.R: El Espíritu Santo {{plural_you:les|os}} mostrará en ese mismo momento lo que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} decir».

fr.L: Car l’Esprit Saint vous enseignera à l’heure même ce qu’il faut dire. »
fr.B: Quand le moment viendra, l’Esprit Saint vous enseignera ce que vous devrez dire. »
fr.R: L’Esprit Saint vous montrera sur le moment ce que vous devez dire. »

sw.L: Kwa maana Roho Mtakatifu atawafundisha saa ile ile yale yanayowapasa kusema."
sw.B: Wakati huo ukifika, Roho Mtakatifu atawafundisha mnachopaswa kusema."
sw.R: Roho Mtakatifu atawaonyesha papo hapo mnachopaswa kusema."

vi.L: vì Đức Thánh Linh sẽ dạy các con trong chính giờ đó những gì phải nói."
vi.B: Khi đến lúc ấy, Đức Thánh Linh sẽ dạy các con những gì cần phải nói."
vi.R: Ngay lúc ấy, Đức Thánh Linh sẽ cho các con biết các con nên nói gì."

ko.L: 성령께서 바로 그때에 너희가 말해야 할 것을 너희에게 가르쳐 주실 것이기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그때가 되면 성령께서 너희가 해야 할 말을 가르쳐 주실 것이다."
ko.R: 그때 그 자리에서 성령께서 너희가 해야 할 말을 알려 주실 것이다."

decisions.choice: the Holy Spirit will teach you: God's Spirit will give the words
alternatives: they will remember what they were taught
decisions.reason: In 21:15 Jesus says that he himself will give the words. Acts shows it happening (Acts 4:8; 6:10).

decisions.choice: must: what it is right and needed to say
decisions.reason: The verb speaks of what is necessary. The Spirit will give what fits the moment.

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here
decisions.reason: In 12:13 a man in the crowd interrupts.

decisions.choice: The honorific for the Holy Spirit ("성령께서 ... 주실")
decisions.reason: The Spirit is God's Spirit, and Korean honours God's action with "께서" and -시-.

source.text: Εἶπεν δέ τις ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου αὐτῷ· Διδάσκαλε, εἰπὲ τῷ ἀδελφῷ μου μερίσασθαι μετ’ ἐμοῦ τὴν κληρονομίαν.

records.literal_gloss: Said then one from the crowd to him, Teacher, say to the brother of me to divide with me the inheritance.

en.L: And someone from the crowd said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."
en.B: Someone in the crowd said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Teacher, tell my brother to share our father's property with me."
en.R: A man in the crowd said to Jesus, "Teacher, my father died and left us his property. Tell my brother to give me my share of it."

es.L: Y uno de la multitud {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo: «Maestro, di a mi hermano que reparta conmigo la herencia».
es.B: Alguien de entre la multitud {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo: «Maestro, dile a mi hermano que comparta conmigo los bienes de nuestro padre».
es.R: Un hombre de la multitud dijo a Jesús: «Maestro, mi padre murió y nos dejó sus bienes. Dile a mi hermano que me dé mi parte».

fr.L: Et quelqu’un de la foule {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit : « Maître, dis à mon frère de partager l’héritage avec moi. »
fr.B: Quelqu’un dans la foule {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit : « Maître, dis à mon frère de partager avec moi les biens de notre père. »
fr.R: Un homme dans la foule a dit à Jésus : « Maître, mon père est mort et nous a laissé ses biens. Dis à mon frère de me donner ma part. »

sw.L: Mtu mmoja katika umati akamwambia, "Mwalimu, mwambie ndugu yangu agawane nami urithi."
sw.B: Mtu mmoja katika umati alimwambia, "Mwalimu, mwambie ndugu yangu tugawane mali ya baba yetu."
sw.R: Mtu mmoja katika umati alimwambia Yesu, "Mwalimu, baba yangu alikufa akatuachia mali yake. Mwambie ndugu yangu anipe sehemu yangu."

vi.L: Có một người trong đám đông nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, xin bảo anh tôi chia gia tài với tôi."
vi.B: Có một người trong đám đông nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thưa Thầy, xin Thầy bảo anh tôi chia cho tôi phần gia tài của cha tôi."
vi.R: Một người trong đám đông nói với Đức Giê-xu: "Thưa Thầy, cha tôi qua đời và để lại tài sản cho chúng tôi. Xin Thầy bảo anh tôi chia cho tôi phần của tôi."

ko.L: 무리 가운데서 어떤 사람이 그분께 말했다. "선생님, 제 형제에게 유산을 저와 나누라고 말씀해 주십시오."
ko.B: 무리 가운데 한 사람이 예수께 말했다. "선생님, 제 형제에게 아버지의 유산을 저와 나누라고 말씀해 주십시오."
ko.R: 무리 가운데 있던 한 남자가 예수께 말했다. "선생님, 저희 아버지께서 돌아가시면서 재산을 남기셨습니다. 제 형제에게 제 몫을 저에게 나누어 주라고 말씀해 주십시오."

decisions.choice: Teacher; inheritance: a teacher of the law was asked to settle a family dispute
decisions.reason: People brought questions of property to respected teachers of the law of Moses, which had rules for inheritance (Numbers 27:1-11; Deuteronomy 21:15-17). The man wants Jesus to take his side.

decisions.choice: divide: share out, so that each has his part
decisions.reason: The brother apparently held the family land undivided and would not give a share.

decisions.choice: our father's property (B); my father died and left us his property (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the inheritance is. That the father had died is implied by an inheritance.

decisions.choice: "anh tôi" for "my brother"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must say whether a brother is older or younger. The one who held the estate and would not share it was most likely the elder, so the man says "anh tôi"; the Greek does not say.

decisions.choice: "선생님" for didaskale; the man speaks to Jesus in 합쇼체 with "제" and "저"; "형제" for adelphos
decisions.reason: Korean must usually say whether a brother is older or younger; the Greek does not, so "형제" is kept.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἄνθρωπε, τίς με κατέστησεν κριτὴν ἢ μεριστὴν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς;

records.literal_gloss: He then said to him, Man, who me appointed a judge or divider over you?

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to him, "Man, who appointed {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a judge or arbitrator over you?"
en.B: Jesus answered, "Friend, who made {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} your judge, or put {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in charge of dividing your property?"
en.R: Jesus answered, "My friend, no one gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} the job of judging between you or dividing your property."

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le dijo: «Hombre, ¿quién {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} puso como juez o repartidor sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?».
es.B: Jesús le respondió: «Amigo, ¿quién {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha nombrado juez de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, o {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha encargado de repartir sus bienes?».
es.R: Jesús le respondió: «Amigo mío, nadie {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha dado el trabajo de juzgar entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ni de repartir sus bienes».

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui dit : « Homme, qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a établi juge ou arbitre sur vous ? »
fr.B: Jésus répondit : « Mon ami, qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a fait votre juge, ou {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a chargé de partager vos biens ? »
fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « Mon ami, personne ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a donné la tâche de juger entre vous ou de partager vos biens. »

sw.L: Lakini akamwambia, "Ewe mtu, ni nani aliyeniweka kuwa mwamuzi au mgawanyaji juu yenu?"
sw.B: Yesu akamjibu, "Rafiki, ni nani aliyenifanya kuwa mwamuzi wenu, au aliyeniweka kuwagawanyia mali yenu?"
sw.R: Yesu akamjibu, "Rafiki yangu, hakuna mtu aliyenipa kazi ya kuwaamua ninyi wala ya kuwagawanyia mali yenu."

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với người ấy: "Này người kia, ai đã lập {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm người xét xử hay người chia gia tài cho các anh?"
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Này anh, ai đã cử {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm quan tòa hay làm người chia tài sản cho các anh?"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Anh bạn ơi, không ai giao cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} việc xét xử hay chia tài sản giữa anh em các anh."

ko.L: 그러나 그분이 그에게 말씀하셨다. "이 사람아, 누가 나를 너희의 재판관이나 [재산을] 나누는 사람으로 세웠느냐?"
ko.B: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "이 사람아, 누가 나를 너희의 재판관으로 세우거나 너희 재산을 나누는 사람으로 세웠느냐?"
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "이 사람아, 너희 사이를 재판하거나 너희 재산을 나누어 주라고 나를 세운 사람은 아무도 없다."

decisions.choice: Man: a plain address, here keeping the man at a distance
decisions.reason: The same address is kind in 5:20. Here it begins a refusal. Jesus will not act as the man's judge.

decisions.choice: who appointed me a judge: words like those spoken to Moses
decisions.reason: An Israelite once said to Moses, "Who made you a ruler and judge over us?" (Exodus 2:14; Acts 7:27). Jesus refuses to take that place in a quarrel over property.

decisions.choice: arbitrator: one who divides an estate between heirs
decisions.reason: The word is rare and is formed from the verb "divide" in 12:13.

decisions.choice: Friend (B); My friend (R)
decisions.reason: In modern English "Man" as an address sounds rough; compare 5:20.

decisions.choice: a statement instead of a question
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer "no one"; Readable gives it.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; sus bienes
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to one man but of the two brothers, so the "you" is plural and takes the setting. "Sus bienes" is left plain: it reads as "their goods" in both forms of Spanish.

decisions.choice: "Này người kia" (L); "Này anh" (B); "Anh bạn ơi" (R) for the address "Man"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the plain address keeps the man at a distance. Literal keeps that coolness; Balanced and Readable use the polite forms for a grown man who is not a disciple, as the English says "Friend".

decisions.choice: "이 사람아" at every level for anthrōpe
alternatives: "친구여", as the English Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the address as plain and keeping the man at a distance; Korean "이 사람아" does that, where "친구여" would sound warmer than the Greek.

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς· Ὁρᾶτε καὶ φυλάσσεσθε ἀπὸ πάσης πλεονεξίας, ὅτι οὐκ ἐν τῷ περισσεύειν τινὶ ἡ ζωὴ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν ἐκ τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐτῷ.

records.literal_gloss: He said then to them, Watch out and keep yourselves from all covetousness, for not in the abounding to anyone the life of him is from the [things] possessing of him.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Watch out, and guard yourselves against all greed, because even when one has abundance, one's life is not from one's possessions."
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Take care! Keep yourselves from every kind of greed. Even when someone has more than enough, life does not come from the things a person owns."
en.R: Then Jesus said to the people, "Be careful! Do not let yourselves want more and more things. Even for people who are very rich, the things they own cannot give them life."

es.L: Y les dijo: «{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} y {{plural_you:guárdense|guardaos}} de toda codicia, porque aun cuando uno tiene abundancia, su vida no viene de sus bienes».
es.B: Luego les dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado! {{plural_you:Guárdense|Guardaos}} de toda clase de codicia. Aunque alguien tenga más que suficiente, la vida no le viene de las cosas que posee».
es.R: Después Jesús le dijo a la gente: «¡{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado! No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que {{plural_you:los|os}} domine el deseo de tener más y más cosas. Aunque una persona sea muy rica, las cosas que tiene no pueden darle la vida».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Voyez et gardez-vous de toute avidité, car même quand on est dans l’abondance, sa vie ne vient pas de ses biens. »
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Faites attention ! Gardez-vous de toute forme d’avidité. Même quand on a plus que le nécessaire, la vie ne vient pas de ce qu’on possède. »
fr.R: Puis Jésus a dit aux gens : « Faites attention ! Ne vous laissez pas aller à vouloir toujours plus de choses. Même pour les gens très riches, ce qu’ils possèdent ne peut pas leur donner la vie. »

sw.L: Akawaambia, "Angalieni na mjilinde na kila tamaa ya kupata zaidi, kwa sababu hata mtu anapokuwa na wingi wa mali, uzima wake hautokani na vitu alivyo navyo."
sw.B: Kisha akawaambia, "Kuweni waangalifu! Jilindeni na kila aina ya tamaa ya mali. Hata mtu akiwa na zaidi ya anachohitaji, uzima hautokani na vitu anavyomiliki."
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawaambia watu, "Kuweni waangalifu! Msijiachie kutamani vitu zaidi na zaidi. Hata kwa watu walio matajiri sana, vitu walivyo navyo haviwezi kuwapa uzima."

vi.L: Ngài lại nói với họ: "Hãy coi chừng và giữ mình khỏi mọi thứ tham lam, vì dù một người có dư dật, sự sống của người ấy cũng không do của cải mình."
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Hãy cẩn thận! Hãy giữ mình khỏi mọi thứ tham lam. Vì ngay cả khi một người có dư dật, sự sống cũng không đến từ những gì người ấy sở hữu."
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nói với dân chúng: "Hãy cẩn thận! Đừng để lòng mình cứ muốn có thêm, thêm nữa. Dù một người rất giàu có, những thứ người ấy có cũng không thể ban cho người ấy sự sống."

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "주의하여 모든 탐욕을 경계하여라. 사람이 아무리 넉넉하여도, 그의 생명은 그의 소유에 있지 않기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그리고 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "조심하여라! 온갖 탐욕을 멀리하여라. 사람이 아무리 많이 가졌어도, 그 생명은 가진 것에서 오지 않는다."
ko.R: 그리고 예수께서 사람들에게 말씀하셨다. "조심하여라! 더 많이 가지려는 욕심을 버려라. 아주 부자인 사람도 자기가 가진 것으로 생명을 얻을 수는 없다."

decisions.choice: greed: the desire to have more
decisions.reason: The word is made of "more" and "have". It is the desire for more than one has, whatever one has already.

decisions.choice: life does not come from possessions, however many
alternatives: life is not measured by possessions
decisions.reason: The sentence is compressed: even when someone has plenty, that person's life does not come out of what he owns. Life is God's gift (12:20).

decisions.choice: life: life itself, being alive
decisions.reason: The word is the ordinary word for life. The parable that follows shows that wealth cannot keep a man alive for one night.

decisions.choice: want more and more things
decisions.reason: Readable says what greed is.

decisions.choice: the people
decisions.reason: Readable says that Jesus speaks to the crowd, including the man who asked.

decisions.choice: l’avidité (L, B)
decisions.reason: "L’avarice" now means stinginess, holding on to money, not the desire to have more (m1). "L’avidité" says that desire plainly; "la cupidité" is close but narrower, the love of money.

decisions.choice: uzima
decisions.reason: Life itself, being alive (meaning decision m3), the word Swahili uses for life as God gives it. "Maisha" would suggest a person's way of living or standard of living, and so a different saying.

decisions.choice: "sự sống" for life (zōē)
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "sự sống" for zōē, life itself (meaning decision), and "mạng sống" for psychē (12:20, 12:22-23).

decisions.choice: "탐욕" (L, B), "더 많이 가지려는 욕심" (R); "생명" for zōē at every level
decisions.reason: "생명" for zōē, "목숨" for psychē, as the Korean style guide settles; both appear in this chapter.

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ παραβολὴν πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγων· Ἀνθρώπου τινὸς πλουσίου εὐφόρησεν ἡ χώρα.

records.literal_gloss: He spoke then a parable to them saying, Of a man certain rich produced abundantly the land.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told them a parable, saying, "The land of a certain rich man produced abundantly.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told them a parable: "There was a rich man whose land gave a huge harvest.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told them a story to teach them: "A rich man owned some farmland. One year it grew a very large crop.

es.L: Y les dijo una parábola, diciendo: «Las tierras de cierto hombre rico produjeron abundantemente.
es.B: Entonces les contó una parábola: «Había un hombre rico cuyas tierras dieron una cosecha enorme.
es.R: Luego les contó una historia para enseñarles: «Un hombre rico tenía unas tierras de cultivo. Un año dieron una cosecha muy grande.

fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur raconta une parabole : « Il y avait un homme riche dont la terre a donné une très grosse récolte.

en.R: The man asked himself, 'What can I do? There is no room to keep all my crops.'

es.L: Y razonaba dentro de sí, diciendo: “¿Qué haré, ya que no tengo dónde guardar mis cosechas?”.
es.B: Y le daba vueltas en su cabeza: “¿Qué voy a hacer? No tengo dónde almacenar mi cosecha”.

fr.L: Et il raisonnait en lui-même, disant : “Que ferai-je, puisque je n’ai pas [de place] où rassembler mes récoltes ?”

en.L: And he said, 'This is what I will do: I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods. \v 19 And I will say to my soul, "Soul, you have many good things laid up for many years. Take your rest, eat, drink, be merry."'

decisions.choice: soul: the self, the man himself with all his desires
alternatives: an immortal part of a person apart from the body
decisions.reason: The word means life or self. The man talks to himself as if to another person. In 12:20 the same word is his life, which God takes back.

decisions.choice: goods: good things, possessions
decisions.reason: The word is "good things", repeated in 12:19. He thinks of them as what makes life good.

decisions.choice: eat, drink, be merry: a saying about enjoying the present
decisions.reason: Ecclesiastes uses similar words (Ecclesiastes 8:15), and Isaiah 22:13 has people say, "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die." The man forgets the second part.

decisions.choice: to myself; You have (B); I have (R)
decisions.reason: Speaking to one's soul sounds like religious language in modern English, which is not what the man means. Balanced and Readable give the sense: he talks to himself.

decisions.choice: double quotation marks inside single ones
decisions.reason: The words he will say to himself are a quotation inside his own words, which are inside Jesus' parable.

decisions.choice: « » for Jesus' parable, “ ” for the rich man's words, ‘ ’ for the words he will say to himself
decisions.reason: French uses « » for the outer quotation and “ ” inside it; for a third level ‘ ’ keeps the three speakers apart, as the English does with its double and single marks.

decisions.choice: nafsi
decisions.reason: The soul here is the man himself with all his desires (meaning decision m1). "Nafsi" is the self; "roho" is also the word for spirit and for the Holy Spirit. Balanced and Readable say "nitajiambia" (I will say to myself), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "nói với linh hồn ta: Linh hồn ơi, mày" (L); "tự nhủ: Mình" (B); "tự nhủ: Ta" (R)
decisions.reason: The soul here is the man himself (meaning decision). Literal keeps his address to his soul, with the familiar "mày" Vietnamese uses in talking to oneself; Balanced and Readable say he talks to himself, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "내 영혼에게 ... 영혼아" (L); "나 자신에게" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "soul" here as the man himself; Literal keeps the word so that 12:20 can answer it.

decisions.choice: fool: a person who lives as if there were no God
decisions.reason: In Scripture the fool is the one who leaves God out (Psalm 14:1). The rich man was clever with his crops but left God out of his plans.

decisions.choice: they are demanding: an indefinite "they", a way of speaking of God's action
decisions.reason: The verb is plural with no subject named. Jewish speech often spoke of God's action this way (6:38). God himself is the one speaking.

decisions.choice: demand back: ask for the return of something lent
decisions.reason: The verb is used of asking for a loan to be repaid (6:30). The man's life was never his own; it was lent to him.

decisions.choice: whose will they be: a question asked in the Psalms and Ecclesiastes
decisions.reason: Psalm 39:7 speaks of a man heaping up wealth without knowing who will gather it, and Ecclesiastes 2:18-19 asks the same about what one leaves behind.

decisions.choice: soul: life
decisions.reason: The same word as in 12:19, now meaning his life itself.

decisions.choice: your life is being asked back from you (B); Tonight you will die. Your life will be taken from you (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the picture, as the meaning decisions explain.

decisions.choice: saved up for yourself
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that he had prepared it all for himself (12:21).

decisions.choice: te reclaman tu alma (L); se te pide que devuelvas tu vida (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is to ask for the return of something lent (meaning decision m3), and the soul here is the man's life (m5). "Reclamar" and "devolver" keep the picture of a loan called in; Literal keeps the indefinite "they" (m2).

decisions.choice: wanaidai (L); unadaiwa urudishwe (B)
