en.R: So stay ready all the time. You do not know when the Son of Man will come. It will be when you are not expecting {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

es.L: También {{plural_you:ustedes estén|vosotros estad}} preparados, porque a la hora que no {{plural_you:piensan|pensáis}} viene el Hijo del Hombre».
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:estén|estad}} preparados también {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. El Hijo del Hombre vendrá a una hora en que no {{plural_you:piensan|pensáis}} que vendrá».
es.R: Por eso, {{plural_you:estén|estad}} siempre listos. {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} cuándo vendrá el Hijo del Hombre. Llegará cuando no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:esperen|esperéis}}».

fr.L: Vous aussi, soyez prêts, car c’est à une heure que vous ne pensez pas que le Fils de l’homme vient. »
fr.B: Soyez donc prêts, vous aussi. Le Fils de l’homme vient à une heure où vous ne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}attendez pas. »
fr.R: Alors restez prêts tout le temps. Vous ne savez pas quand le Fils de l’homme va venir. Il viendra au moment où vous ne {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}attendrez pas. »

sw.L: Nanyi pia kuweni tayari, kwa sababu Mwana wa Adamu anakuja saa msiyoitarajia."
sw.B: Basi ninyi pia kuweni tayari. Mwana wa Adamu anakuja saa ambayo hamdhani kwamba atakuja."
sw.R: Kwa hiyo kaeni tayari wakati wote. Hamjui Mwana wa Adamu atakuja lini. Atakuja wakati msipomtarajia."

vi.L: Các con cũng hãy sẵn sàng, vì Con Người sẽ đến vào giờ các con không ngờ."
vi.B: Vậy các con cũng hãy sẵn sàng, vì Con Người sẽ đến vào giờ các con không nghĩ là {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến."
vi.R: Vậy hãy luôn luôn sẵn sàng. Các con không biết khi nào Con Người sẽ đến. Ngài sẽ đến vào lúc các con không ngờ."

ko.L: 너희도 준비하고 있어라. 너희가 생각하지 않은 때에 인자가 오기 때문이다."
ko.B: 그러니 너희도 준비하고 있어라. 너희가 생각하지 못한 때에 인자가 올 것이다."
ko.R: 그러니 언제나 준비하고 있어라. 인자가 언제 올지 너희는 모른다. 너희가 기다리지 않을 때에 올 것이다."

decisions.choice: the Son of Man is coming: Jesus' return in glory
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of his coming as judge (9:26; 12:8; 21:27).

decisions.choice: be ready: a continuing state
alternatives: get ready at the last minute
decisions.reason: The command is to be and stay ready, since the hour is not known.

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here
decisions.reason: Peter interrupts in 12:41.

source.text: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος· Κύριε, πρὸς ἡμᾶς τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην λέγεις ἢ καὶ πρὸς πάντας;

records.literal_gloss: Said then the Peter, Lord, to us the parable this are you speaking or also to all?

en.L: And Peter said, "Lord, are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} telling this parable to us, or also to everyone?"
en.B: Peter asked, "Lord, is this parable meant for us, or are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} telling it to everyone?"
en.R: Peter said, "Lord, are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} telling this story just for us, or for all the people?"

es.L: Y Pedro dijo: «Señor, ¿dices {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} esta parábola para nosotros, o también para todos?».
es.B: Pedro le preguntó: «Señor, ¿esta parábola es para nosotros, o se la cuentas {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} a todos?».
es.R: Pedro le dijo: «Señor, ¿{{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} nos cuentas esta historia solo a nosotros, o a toda la gente?».

fr.L: Et Pierre dit : « Seigneur, est-ce à nous que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dis cette parabole, ou bien aussi à tous ? »
fr.B: Pierre demanda : « Seigneur, cette parabole est-elle pour nous, ou la racontes-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pour tout le monde ? »
fr.R: Pierre a dit : « Seigneur, est-ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} racontes cette histoire seulement pour nous, ou pour tout le monde ? »

sw.L: Naye Petro akasema, "Bwana, je, unatuambia sisi mfano huu, au kwa wote pia?"
sw.B: Petro akauliza, "Bwana, je, mfano huu ni kwa ajili yetu, au {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unamwambia kila mtu?"
sw.R: Petro akasema, "Bwana, je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unatusimulia mfano huu sisi peke yetu, au unawasimulia watu wote?"

vi.L: Phi-e-rơ nói: "Lạy Chúa, Chúa kể ngụ ngôn này cho chúng con, hay cho mọi người nữa?"
vi.B: Phi-e-rơ hỏi: "Lạy Chúa, ngụ ngôn này Chúa nói cho chúng con thôi, hay cho mọi người?"
vi.R: Phi-e-rơ hỏi: "Lạy Chúa, Chúa kể câu chuyện này chỉ cho chúng con, hay cho tất cả mọi người?"

ko.L: 그러자 베드로가 말했다. "주님, 이 비유를 저희에게 하시는 것입니까, 아니면 모든 사람에게도 [하시는 것입니까]?"
ko.B: 베드로가 물었다. "주님, 이 비유는 저희에게 하시는 말씀입니까, 아니면 모든 사람에게 하시는 말씀입니까?"
ko.R: 베드로가 말했다. "주님, 이 비유는 저희에게만 하시는 말씀입니까, 아니면 여기 있는 모든 사람에게 하시는 말씀입니까?"

decisions.choice: everyone: the whole crowd, not only the Twelve
decisions.reason: Peter asks whether the call to be ready is for the leaders Jesus has chosen or for all who listen (12:1, 12:22).

decisions.choice: this parable: the parable of the watchful slaves and the thief (12:35-40)
alternatives: the parable of the rich man
decisions.reason: Peter's question follows straight on from 12:35-40.

decisions.choice: story
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday word, as in 12:16.

decisions.choice: "Lạy Chúa", "Chúa" for "you", and "chúng con", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Disciples who call Jesus Lord say "Lạy Chúa", use "Chúa" for "you" and "chúng con" for themselves (style guide, section 6); the words of address take no setting span.

decisions.choice: Peter speaks to Jesus in 합쇼체 with "주님" and "저희"
decisions.reason: As the disciples speak to Jesus through the Korean Luke.

source.text: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ κύριος· Τίς ἄρα ἐστὶν ὁ πιστὸς οἰκονόμος, ὁ φρόνιμος, ὃν καταστήσει ὁ κύριος ἐπὶ τῆς θεραπείας αὐτοῦ τοῦ διδόναι ἐν καιρῷ τὸ σιτομέτριον;

records.literal_gloss: And said the Lord, Who then is the faithful manager, the wise, whom will set the master over the household staff of him to give in season the ration of grain?

en.L: And the Lord said, "Who then is the faithful [and] wise manager, whom the master will set over his household staff, to give [them their] ration of grain in its season?
en.B: The Lord answered, "Who, then, is the manager who can be trusted and who acts wisely? His master will put him in charge of the other workers in the household, to give them their share of food when it is due.
en.R: The Lord Jesus answered, "Think of a manager who is faithful and wise. His master puts him in charge of all the other servants in the house. His job is to give them their food at the right time.

es.L: Y dijo el Señor: «¿Quién es, pues, el administrador fiel [y] prudente, a quien el señor pondrá al frente de su servidumbre, para dar[les] a su tiempo la ración de trigo?
es.B: El Señor respondió: «¿Quién es, entonces, el administrador digno de confianza y que obra con prudencia? Su señor lo pondrá a cargo de los demás trabajadores de la casa, para que les dé su parte de comida cuando corresponda.
es.R: El Señor Jesús respondió: «{{plural_you:Piensen|Pensad}} en un administrador fiel y sabio. Su señor lo pone a cargo de todos los demás siervos de la casa. Su trabajo es darles la comida a su hora.

fr.L: Et le Seigneur dit : « Qui donc est l’intendant fidèle [et] avisé que le maître établira sur son personnel, pour [leur] donner en temps voulu la ration de blé ?
fr.B: Le Seigneur répondit : « Qui est donc l’intendant digne de confiance et qui agit avec sagesse ? Son maître le chargera des autres travailleurs de la maison, pour leur donner leur part de nourriture au moment voulu.
fr.R: Le Seigneur Jésus a répondu : « Pensez à un intendant fidèle et sage. Son maître le charge de tous les autres serviteurs de la maison. Son travail, c’est de leur donner leur nourriture au bon moment.

sw.L: Naye Bwana akasema, "Basi ni nani msimamizi mwaminifu, mwenye busara, ambaye bwana atamweka juu ya watumishi wa nyumba yake, ili awape [mgao wao wa] nafaka kwa wakati wake?
sw.B: Bwana akajibu, "Basi, ni nani msimamizi anayeaminika na anayetenda kwa busara? Bwana wake atamweka kuwa msimamizi wa wafanyakazi wengine wa nyumba, awape mgao wao wa chakula wakati unapofika.
sw.R: Bwana Yesu akajibu, "Fikirieni msimamizi mwaminifu na mwenye busara. Bwana wake anamweka kuwa msimamizi wa watumishi wengine wote wa nyumba. Kazi yake ni kuwapa chakula chao kwa wakati unaofaa.

vi.L: Chúa nói: "Vậy ai là người quản gia trung tín và khôn ngoan mà chủ sẽ đặt cai quản những người giúp việc trong nhà, để phát phần lương thực cho họ đúng giờ?
vi.B: Chúa đáp: "Ai là người quản gia đáng tin cậy và khôn ngoan? Người ấy sẽ được chủ giao cho trông coi những người làm trong nhà, để phát phần ăn cho họ đúng lúc.
vi.R: Chúa Giê-xu trả lời: "Hãy nghĩ đến một người quản gia trung tín và khôn ngoan. Chủ giao cho người ấy trông coi tất cả những đầy tớ khác trong nhà. Việc của người ấy là phát thức ăn cho họ đúng giờ.

ko.L: 그러자 주님께서 말씀하셨다. "그러면 주인이 자기 집 종들을 맡겨서 제때에 양식을 나누어 주게 할 신실하고 슬기로운 청지기는 누구냐?
ko.B: 주님께서 대답하셨다. "그러면 믿을 만하고 슬기로운 청지기는 누구냐? 주인은 그런 사람에게 자기 집의 다른 일꾼들을 맡겨서, 제때에 양식을 나누어 주게 할 것이다.
ko.R: 주 예수께서 대답하셨다. "신실하고 지혜로운 관리인을 생각해 보아라. 주인은 그 사람에게 집안의 다른 종들을 모두 맡긴다. 그가 할 일은 제때에 종들에게 먹을 것을 나누어 주는 것이다.

decisions.choice: the Lord: Luke the narrator calls Jesus by his title, beside the master in the parable
decisions.reason: Luke uses the title for Jesus in the story (7:13; 10:1). The same word is used for the master in the parable, which hints at who the master is.

decisions.choice: manager: a steward, often a trusted slave, who ran the household for the owner
decisions.reason: The manager here is himself a slave (12:43). Leaders among Jesus' followers are pictured as such managers (1 Corinthians 4:1-2).

decisions.choice: who then: the question answers Peter by turning it back on him
decisions.reason: Jesus does not say directly whom the parable is for. He describes the faithful manager and lets Peter see himself in the picture.

decisions.choice: household staff: the servants of a household
decisions.reason: The word means service, and so the body of servants who did it.

decisions.choice: ration of food: a measured allowance of grain
decisions.reason: Slaves received a fixed amount of grain at set times.

decisions.choice: the Lord Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable adds the name so that the title is not confused with the master in the parable.

decisions.choice: two sentences instead of one question
alternatives: Who then is the faithful and wise manager whom ...?
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable break the long question to keep it clear.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs on to 12:53
decisions.reason: Jesus' answer to Peter runs to 12:53 with no break.

decisions.choice: el Señor (Jesus); el señor (the master)
decisions.reason: Luke calls Jesus "the Lord" with the same word Jesus uses for the master in the parable (meaning decision m1). Spanish keeps one word, "señor", for both, with the capital for Jesus, so the link stays visible.

decisions.choice: administrador
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for the manager who ran a household for its owner (meaning decision m2). "Mayordomo" today suggests a butler who serves at table.

decisions.choice: l’intendant
decisions.reason: "L’intendant" is the French word for the man who runs an estate for its owner (m2). "L’économe" now suggests a school bursar, and "le gérant" a shop manager.

decisions.choice: Bwana (Jesus); bwana (the master)
decisions.reason: Luke calls Jesus "the Lord" with the same word Jesus uses for the master in the parable (meaning decision m1). Swahili also has one word for both, so the link stays visible, with the capital for Jesus.

decisions.choice: msimamizi
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for the manager who ran a household for its owner (meaning decision m2). "Wakili" today usually means a lawyer or an agent who acts in someone's name.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" (L, B); "Chúa Giê-xu" (R) for the narrator's "the Lord"; "quản gia" for the manager
decisions.reason: As in 11:39 and Luke 7:13: Luke gives Jesus the title "the Lord" beside the master in the parable, whom Vietnamese calls "chủ", so the two do not mix. The manager who ran the household is a "quản gia" (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "주님께서" (L, B), "주 예수께서" (R) for the narrator's "the Lord"; "주인" for the master in the parable
decisions.reason: Korean keeps apart the title of Jesus and the master of the story, which the Greek calls by the same word; the narrator's title as at 11:39.

decisions.choice: "청지기" (L, B), "관리인" (R) for oikonomos
decisions.reason: The man who ran the household for its owner, as the meaning decision says; "청지기" as for epitropos at Luke 8:3.

source.text: μακάριος ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος, ὃν ἐλθὼν ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ εὑρήσει ποιοῦντα οὕτως·

records.literal_gloss: Blessed the slave that, whom having come the master of him will find doing thus.

en.L: Blessed [is] that slave whom his master will find doing so when he comes.
en.B: Blessed is that servant if his master finds him doing just that when he comes home.
en.R: How blessed that servant will be if his master comes home and finds him doing his job!

es.L: Dichoso aquel esclavo a quien su señor, al llegar, encuentre haciendo así.
es.B: Dichoso ese siervo si su señor, al volver a casa, lo encuentra haciendo precisamente eso.
es.R: ¡Qué dichoso será ese siervo si su señor vuelve a casa y lo encuentra haciendo su trabajo!

fr.L: Heureux cet esclave que son maître, en arrivant, trouvera faisant ainsi.
fr.B: Heureux ce serviteur si son maître, en rentrant, le trouve occupé à faire exactement cela.
fr.R: Comme il sera heureux, ce serviteur, si son maître rentre et le trouve en train de faire son travail !

sw.L: Heri mtumwa yule ambaye bwana wake atakapokuja atamkuta akifanya hivyo.
sw.B: Heri mtumishi huyo ikiwa bwana wake atarudi nyumbani na kumkuta akifanya hivyo hasa.
sw.R: Mtumishi huyo atakuwa na heri kubwa ikiwa bwana wake atarudi nyumbani na kumkuta akifanya kazi yake!

vi.L: Phước cho nô lệ ấy, là người mà khi chủ đến sẽ thấy đang làm như vậy.
vi.B: Phước cho đầy tớ ấy nếu khi chủ về thấy người ấy đang làm đúng như vậy.
vi.R: Người đầy tớ ấy thật có phước khi chủ về nhà thấy người ấy đang làm đúng công việc của mình!

ko.L: 주인이 와서 그렇게 하고 있는 것을 보게 될 그 종은 복이 있다.
ko.B: 주인이 돌아와서 그 종이 바로 그렇게 일하고 있는 것을 보면, 그 종은 복이 있다.
ko.R: 주인이 집에 돌아와서 그 종이 자기 일을 잘하고 있는 것을 보면, 그 종은 얼마나 복이 있겠느냐!

decisions.choice: slave: the manager is himself a slave
decisions.reason: The trusted manager of 12:42 belongs to his master like the others.

decisions.choice: How blessed that servant will be
decisions.reason: As in 12:37.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that the person was owned, and Literal keeps "slave".

source.text: ἀληθῶς λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ὑπάρχουσιν αὐτοῦ καταστήσει αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: Truthfully I say to you that over all the possessions of him he will set him.

en.L: In truth I tell you that he will set him over all his possessions.
en.B: I tell you truly, he will put him in charge of everything he owns.
en.R: I tell you the truth, the master will put that servant in charge of everything he owns.

es.L: De verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que lo pondrá al frente de todos sus bienes.
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo de verdad que lo pondrá a cargo de todo lo que tiene.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: el señor pondrá a ese siervo a cargo de todo lo que tiene.

fr.L: Vraiment, je vous dis qu’il l’établira sur tous ses biens.
fr.B: Je vous le dis vraiment : il le chargera de tout ce qu’il possède.
fr.R: Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : le maître chargera ce serviteur de tout ce qu’il possède.

sw.L: Kwa kweli nawaambia kwamba atamweka juu ya mali yake yote.
sw.B: Nawaambia kwa kweli, atamweka kuwa msimamizi wa kila kitu alicho nacho.
sw.R: Nawaambia ukweli, bwana atamweka mtumishi huyo kuwa msimamizi wa kila kitu alicho nacho.

vi.L: Thật, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con rằng chủ sẽ đặt người ấy cai quản tất cả tài sản của mình.
vi.B: Ta nói thật với các con, chủ sẽ giao cho người ấy cai quản tất cả tài sản của mình.
vi.R: Ta nói thật với các con, người chủ sẽ giao cho đầy tớ ấy trông coi mọi thứ ông có.

ko.L: 내가 너희에게 참으로 말한다. 주인은 그에게 자기의 모든 소유를 맡길 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 참으로 말한다. 주인은 자기의 모든 재산을 그에게 맡길 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 분명히 말한다. 주인은 그 종에게 자기의 모든 재산을 맡길 것이다.

decisions.choice: truly: in truth
decisions.reason: Luke has the ordinary word for "truly" here, not the Hebrew word amen (9:27).

decisions.choice: in charge of all his possessions: faithful service is rewarded with greater trust
decisions.reason: The reward for faithful work is more work of the same kind (19:17).

decisions.choice: the master; that servant
decisions.reason: Readable names the two people to keep them apart.

decisions.choice: Vraiment, je vous dis (L); Je vous le dis vraiment (B)
alternatives: En vérité, je vous le dis
decisions.reason: The Greek here is not Jesus' "amen" of 12:37 but a plain adverb, which English renders "In truth". French keeps the difference at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses its usual phrase for both, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Thật, Ta nói với các con" (L); "Ta nói thật với các con" (B, R)
alternatives: "Thật vậy, Ta nói với các con"
decisions.reason: The Greek here is the adverb "truly", not "amen" (meaning decision); Literal keeps it apart from the amen formula of 12:37, and Balanced and Readable use the plain form.

decisions.choice: "내가 너희에게 참으로 말한다" (L, B); "내가 분명히 말한다" (R) for alēthōs
decisions.reason: As at Luke 9:27 in the Korean, where Luke has alēthōs rather than amēn.

source.text: ἐὰν δὲ εἴπῃ ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ· Χρονίζει ὁ κύριός μου ἔρχεσθαι, καὶ ἄρξηται τύπτειν τοὺς παῖδας καὶ τὰς παιδίσκας, ἐσθίειν τε καὶ πίνειν καὶ μεθύσκεσθαι, ἥξει ὁ κύριος τοῦ δούλου ἐκείνου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ οὐ προσδοκᾷ καὶ ἐν ὥρᾳ ᾗ οὐ γινώσκει, καὶ διχοτομήσει αὐτὸν καὶ τὸ μέρος αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἀπίστων θήσει.

records.literal_gloss: If however should say the slave that in the heart of him, Delays the master of me to come, and should begin to beat the menservants and the maidservants, to eat and also to drink and to get drunk, \v 46 will come the master of the slave that in a day in which not he expects and in an hour which not he knows, and will cut in two him, and the portion of him with the unfaithful will appoint.

en.L: But if that slave says in his heart, 'My master is delaying [his] coming,' and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk, \v 46 the master of that slave will come on a day when he does not expect [him] and at an hour he does not know, and will cut him in two and assign his place with the unfaithful.
en.B: But that servant may think, 'My master will be a long while yet.' He may start beating the menservants and the serving girls, and eating and drinking until he is drunk. \v 46 Then his master will arrive on a day the servant does not expect, at an hour he has not guessed. He will cut him to pieces and put him with the unfaithful.
en.R: But suppose that servant thinks, 'My master will not come back for a long time.' So he starts hitting the other servants, men and women alike. He eats and drinks and gets drunk. \v 46 Then one day the master will come back when the servant does not expect him, at a time the servant does not know. The master will punish him very severely. He will send him away to be with those who were not faithful.

es.L: Pero si aquel esclavo dice en su corazón: “Mi señor tarda en venir”, y comienza a golpear a los criados y a las criadas, y a comer y beber y emborracharse, \v 46 vendrá el señor de aquel esclavo en un día en que no [lo] espera y a una hora que no sabe, y lo partirá en dos y le asignará su lugar con los infieles.
es.B: Pero puede que ese siervo piense: “Mi señor va a tardar mucho todavía”. Puede que empiece a golpear a los criados y a las criadas, y a comer y beber hasta emborracharse. \v 46 Entonces su señor llegará un día en que el siervo no lo espera, a una hora que no se imagina. Lo hará pedazos y lo pondrá con los que no fueron fieles.
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:imaginen|imaginad}} que ese siervo piensa: “Mi señor no va a volver en mucho tiempo”. Entonces empieza a pegarles a los otros siervos, tanto hombres como mujeres. Come y bebe y se emborracha. \v 46 Pero un día el señor volverá cuando el siervo no lo espera, a una hora que el siervo no sabe. El señor lo castigará con mucha dureza. Lo echará fuera para que esté con los que no fueron fieles.

fr.L: Mais si cet esclave dit dans son cœur : “Mon maître tarde à venir”, et qu’il se met à battre les serviteurs et les servantes, à manger, à boire et à s’enivrer, \v 46 le maître de cet esclave viendra un jour où il ne [l’]attend pas et à une heure qu’il ne connaît pas ; il le coupera en deux et placera sa part avec les infidèles.
fr.B: Mais ce serviteur pourrait se dire : “Mon maître n’est pas près de revenir.” Il pourrait se mettre à frapper les valets et les servantes, à manger et à boire jusqu’à s’enivrer. \v 46 Alors son maître arrivera un jour où le serviteur ne s’y attend pas, à une heure qu’il n’a pas devinée. Le maître le mettra en pièces et le placera avec ceux qui n’ont pas été fidèles.
fr.R: Mais imaginez que ce serviteur pense : “Mon maître ne reviendra pas avant longtemps.” Et il se met à frapper les autres serviteurs, les hommes comme les femmes. Il mange et il boit jusqu’à être ivre. \v 46 Alors un jour, le maître reviendra au moment où le serviteur ne l’attend pas, à une heure que le serviteur ne connaît pas. Le maître le punira très sévèrement. Il le renverra pour qu’il soit avec ceux qui n’ont pas été fidèles.

sw.L: Lakini mtumwa yule akisema moyoni mwake, 'Bwana wangu anakawia kuja,' na kuanza kuwapiga watumishi wa kiume na vijakazi, na kula na kunywa na kulewa, \v 46 bwana wa mtumwa yule atakuja siku asiyoitarajia na saa asiyoijua, naye atamkata vipande viwili na kumpangia fungu lake pamoja na wasio waaminifu.
sw.B: Lakini huenda mtumishi yule akafikiri, 'Bwana wangu atakawia sana bado.' Huenda akaanza kuwapiga watumishi wa kiume na wa kike, na kula na kunywa hata kulewa. \v 46 Ndipo bwana wake atakapofika siku ambayo mtumishi huyo hamtarajii, saa asiyoikisia. Atamkatakata vipande na kumweka pamoja na wasio waaminifu.
sw.R: Lakini tuseme mtumishi huyo anafikiri, 'Bwana wangu hatarudi kwa muda mrefu.' Kwa hiyo anaanza kuwapiga watumishi wengine, wanaume kwa wanawake. Anakula na kunywa na kulewa. \v 46 Kisha siku moja bwana atarudi wakati mtumishi huyo hamtarajii, saa ambayo mtumishi haijui. Bwana atamwadhibu vikali sana. Atamfukuza akae pamoja na wale ambao hawakuwa waaminifu.

vi.L: Nhưng nếu nô lệ ấy nói trong lòng: 'Chủ ta chậm về,' rồi bắt đầu đánh các tôi trai và tớ gái, ăn uống và say sưa, \v 46 thì chủ của nô lệ ấy sẽ đến vào ngày hắn không trông đợi, vào giờ hắn không biết, và sẽ chặt hắn làm hai, và định phần của hắn với những kẻ bất trung.
vi.B: Nhưng nếu đầy tớ ấy nghĩ thầm: 'Chủ mình còn lâu mới về,' rồi bắt đầu đánh đập các đầy tớ trai và tớ gái, ăn uống say sưa, \v 46 thì chủ của đầy tớ ấy sẽ về vào ngày hắn không ngờ, vào giờ hắn không đoán được. Chủ sẽ chém hắn ra từng mảnh và cho hắn chung số phận với những kẻ bất trung.
vi.R: Nhưng giả sử đầy tớ ấy nghĩ: 'Chủ mình còn lâu lắm mới về.' Rồi hắn bắt đầu đánh những đầy tớ khác, cả nam lẫn nữ. Hắn ăn uống và say sưa. \v 46 Rồi một ngày kia, chủ sẽ trở về vào lúc hắn không ngờ, vào giờ hắn không biết. Chủ sẽ trừng phạt hắn thật nặng nề, và đuổi hắn đi ở chung với những kẻ không trung thành.

ko.L: 그러나 만일 그 종이 마음속으로 '내 주인이 늦게 오는구나' 하고 말하며, 남종들과 여종들을 때리고, 먹고 마시고 취하기 시작하면, \v 46 그 종의 주인이, 그가 기다리지 않는 날, 그가 알지 못하는 때에 와서, 그를 두 동강 내고, 그의 몫을 신실하지 못한 자들과 함께 둘 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 그 종이 마음속으로 '주인은 한참 있어야 오겠지' 하고 생각하면서, 남종들과 여종들을 때리고, 먹고 마시며 술에 취하기 시작한다고 하자. \v 46 그러면 그 종이 생각하지도 못한 날, 짐작하지도 못한 때에 주인이 돌아와서, 그를 두 동강 내고 신실하지 못한 자들과 같은 자리에 둘 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 그 종이 '주인은 오랫동안 돌아오지 않을 거야' 하고 생각한다고 하자. 그래서 다른 종들을, 남자든 여자든 때리기 시작한다. 먹고 마시고 술에 취한다. \v 46 그러면 그 종이 전혀 생각하지 못한 날, 알지 못하는 때에 주인이 돌아올 것이다. 주인은 그 종을 아주 엄하게 벌할 것이다. 그리고 그를 신실하지 못한 사람들이 가는 곳으로 쫓아 보낼 것이다.

decisions.choice: says in his heart: thinks to himself
decisions.reason: In Scripture the heart is where a person thinks and decides (Psalm 14:1).

decisions.choice: menservants and maidservants: the male and female servants of the household
decisions.reason: The first word can mean a boy or a servant, and the second a girl or a female slave (22:56). Here they are the household staff the manager was to feed.

decisions.choice: cut him in two: punish him with the utmost severity
alternatives: cut him off from the household
decisions.reason: The verb means to cut in two, a punishment known in the ancient world (compare 1 Samuel 15:33). Some take it as a strong picture for being cut off. Either way the punishment is final, and the rest of the verse speaks of his place with the unfaithful.

decisions.choice: the unfaithful: those who did not keep faith with their master
decisions.reason: The word can mean unbelieving or untrustworthy. Set against the "faithful" manager of 12:42, it means those who proved unfaithful.

decisions.choice: my master is delaying: the danger of thinking the Lord's coming is far off
alternatives: a statement that he will not come
decisions.reason: The slave does not deny that his master will return, only that it will be soon. Jesus warns his followers against that attitude (12:40).

decisions.choice: the menservants and the serving girls (B); the other servants, men and women alike (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the two words in plain language.

decisions.choice: punish him very severely
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense without the picture, which the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: send him away to be with
decisions.reason: Readable says what the place with the unfaithful means: he is shut out of the household.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable (style guide); Literal keeps "slave". The other servants he beats are the household staff of meaning decision m2.

decisions.choice: los infieles (L); los que no fueron fieles (B, R)
decisions.reason: Those who did not keep faith with their master (meaning decision m4). "Infiel" in Spanish can also mean an unbeliever of another religion, so Balanced and Readable say plainly "those who were not faithful".

decisions.choice: les serviteurs et les servantes (L); les valets et les servantes (B)
decisions.reason: At Balanced "serviteur" already renders the manager's own word (12:43), so the other male servants are "les valets" there, which keeps the two apart; at Literal the manager is "esclave" and "serviteurs" is free.

decisions.choice: watumishi wa kiume na vijakazi (L); watumishi wa kiume na wa kike (B); wanaume kwa wanawake (R)
decisions.reason: The male and female servants of the household (meaning decision m2). Literal says "kijakazi" for a serving girl, the book-wide word; Balanced and Readable say "mtumishi wa kike", as the English says "serving girls".

decisions.choice: "hắn" for the faithless servant
decisions.reason: Once he abuses his trust, the story speaks of him with "hắn", the Vietnamese pronoun for someone the speaker condemns, set against "người ấy" for the faithful servant in 12:42-44.

decisions.choice: "chặt hắn làm hai" (L); "chém hắn ra từng mảnh" (B); "trừng phạt hắn thật nặng nề" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as punishment of the utmost severity, with a footnote; Literal keeps the Greek picture and Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "두 동강 내다" (L, B); "아주 엄하게 벌하다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the hard picture, as the English Balanced does; the meaning decision reads it as punishment of the utmost severity, which Readable says plainly.

decisions.choice: "남종들과 여종들" (L, B), "다른 종들을, 남자든 여자든" (R); "신실하지 못한 자들" for apistoi
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads apistoi as those who did not keep faith with their master, not unbelievers.

source.text: ἐκεῖνος δὲ ὁ δοῦλος ὁ γνοὺς τὸ θέλημα τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ ἑτοιμάσας ἢ ποιήσας πρὸς τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ δαρήσεται πολλάς·

records.literal_gloss: That now the slave, the [one] having known the will of the master of him and not having prepared or having done according to the will of him, will be beaten with many [blows];

en.L: And that slave who knew his master's will and did not prepare or act according to it will be beaten with many [blows];
en.B: A servant who knew his master's wishes but made no preparations and did not carry them out will receive a heavy beating.
en.R: Suppose a servant knows what his master wants him to do, but he does not prepare and does not do it. He will be whipped many times.

es.L: Y aquel esclavo que conoció la voluntad de su señor y no se preparó ni obró conforme a su voluntad recibirá muchos [azotes];
es.B: El siervo que conocía los deseos de su señor, pero no se preparó ni los cumplió, recibirá una fuerte paliza.
es.R: {{plural_you:Imaginen|Imaginad}} a un siervo que sabe lo que su señor quiere que haga, pero no se prepara y no lo hace. Ese siervo recibirá muchos azotes.

fr.L: Et cet esclave qui a connu la volonté de son maître et qui n’a rien préparé ni agi selon sa volonté sera battu de nombreux [coups] ;
fr.B: Le serviteur qui connaissait la volonté de son maître, mais qui n’a rien préparé et ne l’a pas accomplie, recevra une sévère correction.
fr.R: Imaginez un serviteur qui sait ce que son maître veut qu’il fasse, mais qui ne se prépare pas et ne le fait pas. Il recevra beaucoup de coups de fouet.

sw.L: Na mtumwa yule aliyejua mapenzi ya bwana wake na hakujiandaa wala hakutenda kulingana na mapenzi yake atapigwa [mapigo] mengi;
sw.B: Mtumishi aliyejua matakwa ya bwana wake, lakini hakujiandaa wala hakuyatimiza, atapigwa sana.
sw.R: Tuseme mtumishi anajua bwana wake anataka afanye nini, lakini hajiandai wala hafanyi. Mtumishi huyo atachapwa viboko vingi.

vi.L: Nô lệ nào đã biết ý muốn của chủ mình mà không chuẩn bị, hoặc không làm theo ý muốn ấy, thì sẽ bị đánh nhiều [đòn];
vi.B: Đầy tớ nào biết ý chủ mình mà không chuẩn bị sẵn, cũng không làm theo ý chủ, thì sẽ bị đánh đòn nặng.
vi.R: Giả sử một đầy tớ biết chủ muốn mình làm gì, nhưng không chuẩn bị và không làm theo. Người đầy tớ ấy sẽ bị đánh roi nhiều lần.

ko.L: 그러나 자기 주인의 뜻을 알고도 준비하지 않거나 그 뜻대로 행하지 않은 그 종은 많이 맞을 것이다.
ko.B: 주인이 원하는 것을 알고도 아무 준비도 하지 않고 그대로 하지도 않은 종은 매를 많이 맞을 것이다.
ko.R: 어떤 종이 주인이 무엇을 원하는지 알면서도 준비하지 않고 그 일을 하지도 않는다고 하자. 그 종은 매를 많이 맞을 것이다.

decisions.choice: beaten with many blows: flogged
decisions.reason: Masters beat slaves as punishment. The picture is of God's judgment, which takes account of what each person knew.

decisions.choice: will: what the master wanted done
decisions.reason: The word means wish or intention.

decisions.choice: receive a heavy beating
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the sense of the number of blows, which the Greek leaves implied.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable (style guide); Literal keeps "slave".

source.text: ὁ δὲ μὴ γνοὺς ποιήσας δὲ ἄξια πληγῶν δαρήσεται ὀλίγας.

records.literal_gloss: the [one] however not having known, having done however [things] worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few.

en.L: but the one who did not know, and did things deserving of blows, will be beaten with few.
en.B: But a servant who did not know, though he did what deserved a beating, will get a lighter one.
en.R: But a servant who does not know what his master wants, and does something that deserves punishment, will be whipped only a few times.

es.L: pero el que no [la] conoció, e hizo cosas dignas de azotes, recibirá pocos.
es.B: Pero el que no la conocía, aunque hizo cosas que merecían castigo, recibirá una paliza más leve.
es.R: Pero un siervo que no sabe lo que su señor quiere, y hace algo que merece castigo, recibirá solo unos pocos azotes.

fr.L: mais celui qui n’a pas su, et qui a fait des choses dignes de coups, sera battu de peu [de coups].
fr.B: Mais le serviteur qui ne savait pas, même s’il a fait ce qui méritait des coups, en recevra moins.
fr.R: Mais un serviteur qui ne sait pas ce que son maître veut, et qui fait quelque chose qui mérite une punition, recevra seulement quelques coups de fouet.

sw.L: lakini yule asiyejua, akatenda mambo yanayostahili mapigo, atapigwa [mapigo] machache.
sw.B: Lakini mtumishi asiyejua, ingawa alitenda yanayostahili kupigwa, atapigwa kidogo.
sw.R: Lakini mtumishi asiyejua bwana wake anataka nini, akafanya jambo linalostahili adhabu, atachapwa viboko vichache tu.

vi.L: nhưng nô lệ nào không biết, mà làm những điều đáng bị đòn, thì sẽ bị đánh ít [đòn].
vi.B: Còn đầy tớ nào không biết mà làm điều đáng bị đòn, thì sẽ bị đánh nhẹ hơn.
vi.R: Còn đầy tớ nào không biết chủ muốn gì, mà làm điều đáng bị phạt, thì chỉ bị đánh roi ít lần thôi.

ko.L: 그러나 알지 못하고 매 맞을 만한 일을 한 [종은] 적게 맞을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 주인이 원하는 것을 알지 못하고 매 맞을 일을 한 종은 조금 맞을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 주인이 무엇을 원하는지 모르고 벌 받을 일을 한 종은 매를 조금만 맞을 것이다.

decisions.choice: beaten with few: those who did not know are still to blame, but less
alternatives: those who did not know go unpunished
decisions.reason: The law of Moses made a difference between sins done knowingly and those done in ignorance (Numbers 15:27-31). Not knowing lessens the blame but does not remove it.

decisions.choice: will get a lighter one
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the comparison with 12:47.

source.text: παντὶ δὲ ᾧ ἐδόθη πολύ, πολὺ ζητηθήσεται παρ’ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ᾧ παρέθεντο πολύ, περισσότερον αἰτήσουσιν αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: Everyone now to whom was given much, much will be sought from him, and to whom was entrusted much, more abundantly they will ask him.

en.L: And from everyone to whom much was given, much will be required, and from the one to whom much was entrusted, they will ask all the more.
en.B: Much will be asked of everyone who has been given much. And when much has been put in someone's care, even more will be asked of {{gender:that person|him}}.
en.R: God expects much from people to whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has given much. When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has trusted someone with a great deal, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will ask even more from {{gender:that person|him}}.

es.L: Y a todo aquel a quien se le dio mucho, mucho se le exigirá; y a quien se le confió mucho, aún más le pedirán.
es.B: A todo el que se le ha dado mucho se le pedirá mucho. Y cuando se ha puesto mucho en manos de alguien, se le pedirá todavía más.
es.R: Dios espera mucho de las personas a quienes ha dado mucho. Cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} confía mucho a alguien, le pedirá todavía más.

fr.L: Et à quiconque il a été beaucoup donné, il sera beaucoup demandé ; et à celui à qui l’on a beaucoup confié, on réclamera encore plus.
fr.B: Beaucoup sera demandé à quiconque a reçu beaucoup. Et quand on a confié beaucoup à quelqu’un, on lui réclamera encore davantage.
fr.R: Dieu attend beaucoup de ceux à qui {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a beaucoup donné. Quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a confié beaucoup à quelqu’un, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui demandera encore plus.

sw.L: Na kila mtu aliyepewa mengi, mengi yatadaiwa kutoka kwake; na yule aliyekabidhiwa mengi, watamdai zaidi.
sw.B: Kila aliyepewa mengi, mengi yatatakiwa kwake. Na mtu aliyekabidhiwa mengi atadaiwa zaidi hata kuliko hayo.
sw.R: Mungu anatarajia mengi kwa watu aliowapa mengi. Akimkabidhi mtu vitu vingi, atamdai hata zaidi.

vi.L: Ai được cho nhiều, thì sẽ bị đòi lại nhiều; và ai được giao phó nhiều, thì người ta sẽ đòi nơi người ấy nhiều hơn nữa.
vi.B: Ai đã được ban cho nhiều thì sẽ bị đòi lại nhiều. Ai được giao phó nhiều thì sẽ bị đòi hỏi nhiều hơn nữa.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đòi hỏi nhiều nơi người được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho nhiều. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giao phó cho ai nhiều, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đòi nơi người ấy nhiều hơn nữa.

ko.L: 많이 받은 모든 사람에게서는 많이 요구될 것이고, 많이 맡겨진 사람에게서는 더 많은 것을 요구할 것이다.
ko.B: 많이 받은 사람에게는 많이 요구되고, 많이 맡은 사람에게는 더 많은 것이 요구될 것이다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 많이 주신 사람에게 많이 요구하신다. 많은 것을 맡기신 사람에게는 더 많은 것을 요구하실 것이다.

decisions.choice: was given; was entrusted; they will ask: God gives, and God will ask
decisions.reason: The passives and the indefinite "they" point to God, as in 12:20.

decisions.choice: entrusted: given into someone's care to look after
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a deposit left in someone's keeping. What is entrusted must be accounted for.

decisions.choice: all the more: more than was given
decisions.reason: The word is a comparative. The second half of the saying goes further than the first.

decisions.choice: {{gender:that person|him}}
decisions.reason: The saying is for everyone; the inclusive form is the default.

decisions.choice: God expects; he has given; he will ask
alternatives: much will be required; was given; they will ask
decisions.reason: Readable names God, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: "on lui réclamera", "il lui demandera", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The pronoun refers back to "quelqu’un", which is generic, so French needs no span where English has {{gender:that person|him}} (as in 12:8).

decisions.choice: No gender span: "사람" at every level, where the English has one (B, R)
alternatives: a gender span with "남자" as the alternative
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" already includes men and women, and Korean leaves out the pronoun.

source.text: Πῦρ ἦλθον βαλεῖν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν, καὶ τί θέλω εἰ ἤδη ἀνήφθη;

records.literal_gloss: Fire I came to cast upon the earth, and what I wish if already it were kindled!

en.L: I came to cast fire upon the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!
en.B: I came to set fire to the earth, and how I long for it to be blazing already!
en.R: I came to bring fire to the earth. I wish that it were already burning!

es.L: Vine a arrojar fuego sobre la tierra, ¡y cómo quisiera que ya estuviera encendido!
es.B: Vine a prender fuego a la tierra, ¡y cuánto deseo que ya esté ardiendo!
es.R: Vine a traer fuego a la tierra. ¡Ojalá ya estuviera ardiendo!

fr.L: C’est un feu que je suis venu jeter sur la terre, et comme je voudrais qu’il soit déjà allumé !
fr.B: Je suis venu mettre le feu à la terre, et comme je voudrais qu’il flambe déjà !
fr.R: Je suis venu apporter le feu sur la terre. Je voudrais qu’il brûle déjà !

sw.L: Nilikuja kutupa moto juu ya nchi, na laiti ungekuwa umekwisha kuwashwa!
sw.B: Nilikuja kuwasha moto duniani, na jinsi ninavyotamani uwe tayari unawaka!
sw.R: Nilikuja kuleta moto duniani. Laiti ungekuwa tayari unawaka!

vi.L: Ta đến để ném lửa xuống đất, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ước gì lửa ấy đã cháy lên rồi!
vi.B: Ta đến để châm lửa trên mặt đất, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khao khát biết bao lửa ấy đã bùng cháy rồi!
vi.R: Ta đến để đem lửa xuống đất. Ta ước gì lửa ấy đã cháy lên rồi!

ko.L: 나는 땅에 불을 던지러 왔다. 그 불이 이미 붙었다면 얼마나 좋겠느냐!
ko.B: 나는 땅에 불을 지르러 왔다. 그 불이 벌써 타오르고 있다면 얼마나 좋겠느냐!
ko.R: 나는 세상에 불을 가져오려고 왔다. 그 불이 벌써 타오르고 있으면 좋겠다!

decisions.choice: fire: God's judgment, which also purifies, and which comes with the Holy Spirit
alternatives: the fire of the Spirit only
decisions.reason: John said that the one coming after him would baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire, and would burn up the chaff (3:16-17). Jesus' coming brings that fire: it tests and divides people (12:51-53).

decisions.choice: how I wish it were already kindled: a longing that is not yet fulfilled
alternatives: what do I want, if it is already kindled?
decisions.reason: The words can be read as a question, but they are best taken as a cry of longing, matching 12:50.

decisions.choice: bring
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plain verb. Literal keeps "cast".

decisions.choice: set fire to
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the picture of lighting a fire, which 12:49b continues.

source.text: βάπτισμα δὲ ἔχω βαπτισθῆναι, καὶ πῶς συνέχομαι ἕως ὅτου τελεσθῇ.

records.literal_gloss: Baptism however I have to be baptized, and how I am distressed until that it be accomplished!

en.L: But I have a baptism to be baptized [with], and how I am pressed until it is completed!
en.B: But first I must go through a baptism, and I am under great strain until it is over!
en.R: But first I must suffer terrible things, as if a flood were going over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} head. I will be very troubled until it is finished!

es.L: Pero tengo un bautismo que recibir, ¡y qué apremiado estoy hasta que se haya cumplido!
es.B: Pero antes tengo que pasar por un bautismo, ¡y qué angustia siento hasta que termine!
es.R: Pero antes tengo que sufrir cosas terribles, como si una inundación pasara por encima de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} cabeza. ¡Estaré muy angustiado hasta que todo termine!

fr.L: Mais j’ai un baptême [dont] être baptisé, et combien je suis oppressé jusqu’à ce qu’il soit accompli !
fr.B: Mais je dois d’abord passer par un baptême, et je suis dans une grande angoisse jusqu’à ce qu’il soit achevé !
fr.R: Mais d’abord, je dois souffrir des choses terribles, comme si un flot passait par-dessus {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} tête. Je serai très troublé jusqu’à ce que ce soit fini !

sw.L: Lakini nina ubatizo wa kubatizwa, na jinsi ninavyobanwa mpaka utimizwe!
sw.B: Lakini kwanza lazima nipitie ubatizo, na ninasongwa sana mpaka umalizike!
sw.R: Lakini kwanza lazima nipate mateso makali, kana kwamba mafuriko yanapita juu ya kichwa {{deity_pronoun:changu|Changu}}. Nitahangaika sana mpaka hayo yamekwisha!

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có một phép báp-têm phải chịu, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bị thúc bách biết bao cho đến khi việc ấy được hoàn tất!
vi.B: Nhưng trước hết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phải chịu một phép báp-têm, và lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nặng trĩu biết bao cho đến khi điều ấy được hoàn tất!
vi.R: Nhưng trước hết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phải chịu những đau đớn khủng khiếp, như nước lũ tràn ngập trên đầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta sẽ rất khổ tâm cho đến khi mọi việc ấy hoàn tất!

ko.L: 그러나 나는 받아야 할 세례가 있다. 그것이 다 이루어질 때까지 내가 얼마나 짓눌리는지 모른다!
ko.B: 그러나 먼저 나는 받아야 할 세례가 있다. 그 일이 끝날 때까지 내 마음이 얼마나 답답한지 모른다!
ko.R: 그러나 그 전에 나는 큰 고난을 겪어야 한다. 마치 큰 물결이 내 머리 위로 덮치는 것과 같은 고난이다. 그 일이 다 끝날 때까지 나는 몹시 괴로울 것이다!

decisions.choice: a baptism to be baptized with: his suffering and death
decisions.reason: Jesus uses the same picture in Mark 10:38-39. To be baptized is to be plunged under water, and in the Psalms deep waters picture overwhelming trouble (Psalm 42:8; 69:2-3).

decisions.choice: distressed: pressed hard, held in its grip
decisions.reason: The verb means to press together or hold fast. It can describe anguish (8:45; Philippians 1:23). Here Jesus is weighed down until his suffering is complete.

decisions.choice: accomplished: completed, brought to its end
decisions.reason: The verb is used of what Scripture says about Jesus being fulfilled (18:31; 22:37).

decisions.choice: first
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "first" to show that the baptism comes before the fire is lit (compare 17:25).

decisions.choice: suffer terrible things, as if a flood were going over my head
alternatives: a baptism to be baptized with
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture, as the meaning decision does.

decisions.choice: I am under great strain
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the sense of the verb in everyday words.

decisions.choice: "phép báp-têm phải chịu" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The baptism is his suffering and death (meaning decision). "báp-têm" is the settled Protestant word, so the picture stays at Literal and Balanced; Readable says what it means with the picture of a flood, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "세례" (L, B); "큰 물결이 머리 위로 덮치는 것과 같은 고난" (R); "짓눌리다" (L), "답답하다" (B), "괴롭다" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the baptism as his suffering and death; Readable explains the picture as the English Readable does.

source.text: δοκεῖτε ὅτι εἰρήνην παρεγενόμην δοῦναι ἐν τῇ γῇ;

records.literal_gloss: Do you think that peace I came to give on the earth?

en.L: Do you think that I came to give peace on the earth?
en.B: Do you suppose that I came to bring peace to the earth?
en.R: Do you think I came so that there would be peace in the world?

es.L: ¿{{plural_you:Creen|Creéis}} que vine a dar paz en la tierra?
es.B: ¿{{plural_you:Suponen|Suponéis}} que vine a traer paz a la tierra?
es.R: ¿{{plural_you:Creen|Creéis}} que vine para que haya paz en el mundo?

fr.L: Croyez-vous que c’est la paix que je suis venu donner sur la terre ?
fr.B: Vous imaginez-vous que je suis venu apporter la paix à la terre ?
fr.R: Pensez-vous que je suis venu pour que les gens vivent en paix dans le monde ?

sw.L: Mnafikiri kwamba nilikuja kutoa amani katika nchi?
sw.B: Je, mnadhani nilikuja kuleta amani duniani?
sw.R: Mnafikiri nilikuja ili kuwe na amani ulimwenguni?

vi.L: Các con tưởng rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến để ban bình an trên đất sao?
vi.B: Các con nghĩ rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến để đem bình an cho mặt đất sao?
vi.R: Các con nghĩ rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến để thế gian được bình an sao?

ko.L: 너희는 내가 땅에 평화를 주려고 왔다고 생각하느냐?
ko.B: 너희는 내가 세상에 평화를 가져오려고 왔다고 생각하느냐?
ko.R: 너희는 내가 세상에 평화가 있게 하려고 왔다고 생각하느냐?

decisions.choice: peace: not peace with God, but an easy peace among people
decisions.reason: The angels announced peace on earth (2:14), and Jesus gives peace to those who trust him (7:50). But his coming also forces people to choose, and that divides them (2:34-35).

decisions.choice: world
decisions.reason: Readable says "world" for the earth as the home of people.

decisions.choice: "평화", not the key word "평안"
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Matthew 10:34: the meaning decision reads this as an easy peace among people, not the peace Jesus gives.

source.text: οὐχί, λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀλλ’ ἢ διαμερισμόν.

records.literal_gloss: No, I say to you, but rather division.

en.L: No, I tell you, but rather division.
en.B: No, I tell you, I came to bring division.
en.R: No, I tell you. I came to make people take sides against each other.

es.L: No, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo, sino más bien división.
es.B: No, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo; vine a traer división.
es.R: No, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo. Vine a hacer que la gente se ponga de un lado o de otro, unos contra otros.

fr.L: Non, je vous [le] dis, mais plutôt la division.
fr.B: Non, je vous le dis, je suis venu apporter la division.
fr.R: Non, je vous le dis. Je suis venu pour que les gens prennent parti les uns contre les autres.

sw.L: Hapana, nawaambia, bali zaidi mgawanyiko.
sw.B: Hapana, nawaambia, nilikuja kuleta mgawanyiko.
sw.R: Hapana, nawaambia. Nilikuja kuwafanya watu wachague upande, kila mmoja dhidi ya mwenzake.

vi.L: Không, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, nhưng đúng hơn là sự chia rẽ.
vi.B: Không, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến để đem sự chia rẽ.
vi.R: Không phải đâu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con. Ta đến để làm cho người ta chia phe chống lại nhau.

ko.L: 아니다. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 오히려 분열을 [주려고 왔다].
ko.B: 아니다. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 나는 분열을 일으키려고 왔다.
ko.R: 아니다. 내가 너희에게 말한다. 나는 사람들이 서로 편이 갈라져 맞서게 하려고 왔다.

decisions.choice: division: people split apart from one another
decisions.reason: Matthew 10:34 has "a sword"; Luke says what the sword does.

decisions.choice: I came to bring
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable repeat the verb from 12:51a.

decisions.choice: make people take sides against each other
decisions.reason: Readable says what division means.

source.text: ἔσονται γὰρ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν πέντε ἐν ἑνὶ οἴκῳ διαμεμερισμένοι, τρεῖς ἐπὶ δυσὶν καὶ δύο ἐπὶ τρισίν, διαμερισθήσονται πατὴρ ἐπὶ υἱῷ καὶ υἱὸς ἐπὶ πατρί, μήτηρ ἐπὶ θυγατέρα καὶ θυγάτηρ ἐπὶ τὴν μητέρα, πενθερὰ ἐπὶ τὴν νύμφην αὐτῆς καὶ νύμφη ἐπὶ τὴν πενθεράν.

records.literal_gloss: There will be for from the now five in one house divided, three against two and two against three; \v 53 they will be divided father against son and son against father, mother against the daughter and daughter against the mother, mother-in-law against the daughter-in-law of her and daughter-in-law against the mother-in-law.

en.L: For from now on there will be five in one household divided, three against two and two against three; \v 53 they will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law."
en.B: From now on, a family of five will be split, three against two and two against three. \v 53 Father will turn against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, a woman against her son's wife and the wife against her husband's mother."
en.R: From now on, families will be divided. In a family of five people, three will be against two, and two will be against three. \v 53 Fathers and sons will be against each other. Mothers and daughters will be against each other. Mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law will be against each other."

es.L: Porque desde ahora habrá cinco en una casa divididos, tres contra dos y dos contra tres; \v 53 estarán divididos padre contra hijo e hijo contra padre, madre contra hija e hija contra la madre, suegra contra su nuera y nuera contra la suegra».
es.B: De ahora en adelante, una familia de cinco estará dividida, tres contra dos y dos contra tres. \v 53 El padre se pondrá contra el hijo y el hijo contra el padre, la madre contra la hija y la hija contra la madre, la suegra contra su nuera y la nuera contra su suegra».
es.R: De ahora en adelante, las familias estarán divididas. En una familia de cinco personas, tres estarán contra dos, y dos estarán contra tres. \v 53 Padres e hijos estarán unos contra otros. Madres e hijas estarán unas contra otras. Suegras y nueras estarán unas contra otras».

fr.L: Car désormais il y aura cinq [personnes] divisées dans une seule maison, trois contre deux et deux contre trois ; \v 53 elles seront divisées, père contre fils et fils contre père, mère contre fille et fille contre mère, belle-mère contre sa belle-fille et belle-fille contre belle-mère. »
fr.B: Désormais, une famille de cinq sera divisée, trois contre deux et deux contre trois. \v 53 Le père se dressera contre le fils et le fils contre le père, la mère contre la fille et la fille contre la mère, une femme contre l’épouse de son fils et l’épouse contre la mère de son mari. »
fr.R: À partir de maintenant, les familles seront divisées. Dans une famille de cinq personnes, trois seront contre deux, et deux contre trois. \v 53 Les pères et les fils seront les uns contre les autres. Les mères et les filles seront les unes contre les autres. Les belles-mères et les belles-filles seront les unes contre les autres. »

sw.L: Kwa maana tangu sasa watakuwa watano katika nyumba moja wamegawanyika, watatu dhidi ya wawili na wawili dhidi ya watatu; \v 53 watagawanyika baba dhidi ya mwana na mwana dhidi ya baba, mama dhidi ya binti na binti dhidi ya mama, mama mkwe dhidi ya mkaza mwana wake na mkaza mwana dhidi ya mama mkwe."
sw.B: Tangu sasa jamaa ya watu watano itagawanyika, watatu dhidi ya wawili na wawili dhidi ya watatu. \v 53 Baba atampinga mwana na mwana atampinga baba, mama atampinga binti na binti atampinga mama, mama mkwe atampinga mkaza mwana wake na mkaza mwana atampinga mama mkwe wake."
sw.R: Tangu sasa jamaa zitagawanyika. Katika jamaa ya watu watano, watatu watakuwa dhidi ya wawili, na wawili dhidi ya watatu. \v 53 Baba na wana watakuwa dhidi ya kila mmoja. Mama na binti watakuwa dhidi ya kila mmoja. Mama wakwe na wakaza wana watakuwa dhidi ya kila mmoja."

vi.L: Vì từ nay về sau, năm người trong một nhà sẽ chia rẽ nhau, ba chống hai và hai chống ba; \v 53 họ sẽ chia rẽ nhau: cha chống con trai và con trai chống cha, mẹ chống con gái và con gái chống mẹ, mẹ chồng chống con dâu và con dâu chống mẹ chồng."
vi.B: Từ nay trở đi, một gia đình năm người sẽ chia rẽ, ba người chống lại hai và hai người chống lại ba. \v 53 Cha sẽ chống lại con trai và con trai chống lại cha, mẹ chống lại con gái và con gái chống lại mẹ, mẹ chồng chống lại con dâu và con dâu chống lại mẹ chồng."
vi.R: Từ nay trở đi, các gia đình sẽ bị chia rẽ. Trong một gia đình có năm người, ba người sẽ chống lại hai, và hai người sẽ chống lại ba. \v 53 Cha và con trai sẽ chống lại nhau. Mẹ và con gái sẽ chống lại nhau. Mẹ chồng và con dâu sẽ chống lại nhau."

ko.L: 이제부터 한 집에 있는 다섯 사람이 갈라져서, 셋이 둘에게, 둘이 셋에게 맞설 것이기 때문이다. \v 53 아버지가 아들에게, 아들이 아버지에게, 어머니가 딸에게, 딸이 어머니에게, 시어머니가 자기 며느리에게, 며느리가 시어머니에게 맞서 갈라질 것이다."
ko.B: 이제부터는 한 집안 식구 다섯 사람이 갈라져, 셋이 둘에게 맞서고 둘이 셋에게 맞설 것이다. \v 53 아버지가 아들에게, 아들이 아버지에게 맞서고, 어머니가 딸에게, 딸이 어머니에게 맞서고, 시어머니가 며느리에게, 며느리가 시어머니에게 맞설 것이다."
ko.R: 이제부터는 가족들이 서로 갈라질 것이다. 다섯 식구가 사는 집에서 세 사람은 두 사람과, 두 사람은 세 사람과 맞설 것이다. \v 53 아버지와 아들이 서로 맞설 것이다. 어머니와 딸이 서로 맞설 것이다. 시어머니와 며느리가 서로 맞설 것이다."

decisions.choice: father against son ... daughter-in-law against mother-in-law: Micah 7:6
decisions.reason: Micah described a time so evil that a man's enemies were the people of his own house. Jesus uses his words for the division that following him will bring into families.

decisions.choice: five in one house: a household of parents and a married son
decisions.reason: A son brought his wife to live in his parents' home. The five are father, mother, daughter, son, and son's wife: the people named in 12:53.

decisions.choice: from now on: from the time of Jesus' coming
alternatives: at the end of the world only
decisions.reason: The division has already begun (2:34-35).

decisions.choice: a woman against her son's wife and the wife against her husband's mother
decisions.reason: Balanced says who the in-laws are, which also shows the household of 12:52.

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here
decisions.reason: The narrator speaks again in 12:54.

decisions.choice: la suegra contra su nuera
alternatives: una mujer contra la esposa de su hijo
decisions.reason: The English Balanced spells out "her son's wife" and "her husband's mother" because "daughter-in-law" and "mother-in-law" are heavy in a list. Spanish "suegra" and "nuera" are short everyday words, so Balanced keeps them.

decisions.choice: mama mkwe; mkaza mwana
decisions.reason: "Mkaza mwana" is a son's wife and "mama mkwe" a husband's mother; "mkwe" alone can be any in-law, so it would not say which woman is set against which (as Matthew 10:35).

decisions.choice: "mẹ chồng" and "con dâu" (B)
alternatives: "người đàn bà và vợ của con trai mình"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has exact everyday words for a woman's mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, so Balanced needs none of the English paraphrase.

decisions.choice: "시어머니", "며느리" at every level
alternatives: a description, as the English Balanced "her son's wife"
decisions.reason: Korean has exact words for mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, as in the Korean Matthew 10:35.

source.text: Ἔλεγεν δὲ καὶ τοῖς ὄχλοις· Ὅταν ἴδητε νεφέλην ἀνατέλλουσαν ἐπὶ δυσμῶν, εὐθέως λέγετε ὅτι Ὄμβρος ἔρχεται, καὶ γίνεται οὕτως·

records.literal_gloss: He was saying now also to the crowds, When you see a cloud rising up from [the] west, immediately you say that, A rainstorm is coming, and it happens so;

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was also saying to the crowds, "When you see a cloud rising in the west, at once you say, 'A rainstorm is coming,' and so it happens.
en.B: Jesus also said to the crowds, "When you see a cloud coming up in the west, you say straight away, 'There will be rain,' and so there is.
en.R: Jesus also said to the crowds, "When you see clouds building up in the west, you say at once, 'Rain is on the way.' And you are right.

es.L: Y decía también a las multitudes: «Cuando {{plural_you:ven|veis}} una nube que sube por el poniente, enseguida {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “Viene aguacero”, y así sucede.
es.B: Jesús dijo también a las multitudes: «Cuando {{plural_you:ven|veis}} que una nube se levanta por el oeste, {{plural_you:dicen|decís}} en seguida: “Va a llover”, y así es.
es.R: Jesús también dijo a la multitud: «Cuando {{plural_you:ven|veis}} que se juntan nubes en el oeste, {{plural_you:dicen|decís}} enseguida: “Viene la lluvia”. Y {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} razón.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} disait aussi aux foules : « Quand vous voyez un nuage se lever à l’ouest, aussitôt vous dites : “Une averse arrive”, et il en est ainsi.
fr.B: Jésus dit aussi aux foules : « Quand vous voyez un nuage monter à l’ouest, vous dites tout de suite : “Il va pleuvoir”, et c’est ce qui se passe.
fr.R: Jésus a dit aussi aux foules : « Quand vous voyez des nuages se former à l’ouest, vous dites aussitôt : “La pluie arrive.” Et vous avez raison.

sw.L: Akawaambia pia makutano, "Mnapoona wingu likipanda upande wa magharibi, mara moja mnasema, 'Mvua kubwa inakuja,' na ndivyo inavyokuwa.
sw.B: Yesu akawaambia pia makundi ya watu, "Mnapoona wingu likitokea magharibi, mnasema mara moja, 'Mvua itanyesha,' na ndivyo inavyotokea.
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia pia makundi ya watu, "Mnapoona mawingu yakijikusanya upande wa magharibi, mnasema mara moja, 'Mvua inakuja.' Nanyi mko sahihi.

vi.L: Ngài cũng nói với các đoàn dân: "Khi các người thấy một đám mây nổi lên ở phía tây, các người lập tức nói: 'Mưa lớn sắp đến,' và quả như vậy.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu cũng nói với dân chúng: "Khi các người thấy mây nổi lên ở phía tây, các người nói ngay: 'Trời sắp mưa,' và quả nhiên trời mưa.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu cũng nói với dân chúng: "Khi các người thấy mây kéo đến từ phía tây, các người nói ngay: 'Sắp mưa rồi.' Và các người nói đúng.

ko.L: 그분이 또 무리에게 말씀하고 계셨다. "너희는 서쪽에서 구름이 일어나는 것을 보면, 곧 '소나기가 온다' 하고 말한다. 그러면 그대로 된다.
ko.B: 예수께서 무리에게도 말씀하셨다. "너희는 서쪽에서 구름이 올라오는 것을 보면, 곧바로 '비가 오겠다' 하고 말한다. 그러면 정말 비가 온다.
ko.R: 예수께서 무리에게도 말씀하셨다. "너희는 서쪽 하늘에 구름이 몰려오는 것을 보면, 바로 '비가 오겠구나' 하고 말한다. 그러면 너희 말대로 된다.

decisions.choice: a cloud in the west: rain coming in from the Mediterranean Sea
decisions.reason: In the land of Israel the sea lies to the west, and the rain clouds come from it (1 Kings 18:44).

decisions.choice: the crowds: the people as a whole, now addressed after the disciples
decisions.reason: Jesus turns from his disciples (12:22, 41) to the crowd (12:1).

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs on to 12:59; the people's sayings are in single quotation marks
decisions.reason: Jesus' words to the crowds in 12:54-59 are one speech.

decisions.choice: "các người" for the crowds (12:54-59), and "anh" for the singular "you" in 12:58-59
decisions.reason: Jesus now turns from the disciples to the crowds (meaning decision); the style guide gives "các người" for crowds, and the singular of 12:58-59 is "anh", as in 11:34-36.

decisions.choice: "말씀하고 계셨다" (L) for the imperfect; "곧" (L), "곧바로" (B), "바로" (R) for eutheōs; the people's sayings in single quotation marks
decisions.reason: The Literal keeps the Greek's continuing past; eutheōs is rendered as in 12:36.

source.text: καὶ ὅταν νότον πνέοντα, λέγετε ὅτι Καύσων ἔσται, καὶ γίνεται.

records.literal_gloss: and when a south wind is blowing, you say that, Heat will be, and it happens.

en.L: And when a south wind is blowing, you say, 'There will be scorching heat,' and it happens.
en.B: And when the south wind is blowing, you say, 'A scorching day is coming,' and so it turns out.
en.R: When the wind comes from the south, you say, 'It will be very hot today.' And it turns out hot.

es.L: Y cuando sopla el viento del sur, {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “Hará un calor abrasador”, y sucede.
es.B: Y cuando sopla el viento del sur, {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “Viene un día de calor abrasador”, y así resulta.
es.R: Cuando el viento viene del sur, {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: “Hoy va a hacer mucho calor”. Y hace calor.

fr.L: Et quand le vent du sud souffle, vous dites : “Il fera une chaleur brûlante”, et cela arrive.
fr.B: Et quand le vent du sud souffle, vous dites : “La journée sera torride”, et c’est bien ce qui arrive.
fr.R: Quand le vent vient du sud, vous dites : “Il va faire très chaud aujourd’hui.” Et il fait très chaud.

sw.L: Na upepo wa kusini unapovuma, mnasema, 'Kutakuwa na joto kali,' na hutokea.
sw.B: Na upepo wa kusini unapovuma, mnasema, 'Siku ya joto kali inakuja,' na ndivyo inavyokuwa.
sw.R: Upepo unapovuma kutoka kusini, mnasema, 'Leo kutakuwa na joto sana.' Na kweli kunakuwa na joto.

vi.L: Và khi gió nam thổi, các người nói: 'Sẽ có nắng nóng gay gắt,' và điều đó xảy ra.
vi.B: Khi gió nam thổi, các người nói: 'Trời sẽ nóng như thiêu,' và quả thật như vậy.
vi.R: Khi gió thổi từ phía nam, các người nói: 'Hôm nay trời sẽ rất nóng.' Và trời nóng thật.

ko.L: 그리고 남풍이 부는 [것을 보면], '무더위가 올 것이다' 하고 말한다. 그러면 그렇게 된다.
ko.B: 또 남풍이 불면 '몹시 덥겠다' 하고 말한다. 그러면 그대로 된다.
ko.R: 남쪽에서 바람이 불어오면, '오늘은 아주 덥겠구나' 하고 말한다. 그러면 정말 덥다.

decisions.choice: a south wind: hot, dry wind off the desert
decisions.reason: To the south and east of Israel lies desert. Wind from there brings burning heat (Job 37:17).

decisions.choice: scorching heat: burning heat
decisions.reason: The word is used of the heat of the sun (Matthew 20:12).

source.text: ὑποκριταί, τὸ πρόσωπον τῆς γῆς καὶ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ οἴδατε δοκιμάζειν, τὸν δὲ καιρὸν τοῦτον πῶς οὐκ οἴδατε δοκιμάζειν;

records.literal_gloss: Hypocrites, the appearance of the earth and of the sky you know to discern, the however time this how not you know to discern?

en.L: Hypocrites! You know how to discern the face of the earth and of the sky, but how is it that you do not discern this time?
en.B: You hypocrites! You can read the face of the earth and the sky. How is it, then, that you cannot read what this moment means?
en.R: You are pretending! You can look at the earth and the sky and know what the weather will be. So why do you not understand what is happening now, at this time?

es.L: ¡Hipócritas! El aspecto de la tierra y del cielo {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} examinar, pero este tiempo, ¿cómo es que no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} examinarlo?
es.B: ¡Hipócritas! {{plural_you:Saben|Sabéis}} leer el aspecto de la tierra y del cielo. ¿Cómo es, entonces, que no {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} leer lo que significa este momento?
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Ustedes solo están fingiendo|Vosotros solo estáis fingiendo}}! {{plural_you:Pueden|Podéis}} mirar la tierra y el cielo y saber qué tiempo va a hacer. Entonces, ¿por qué no {{plural_you:entienden|entendéis}} lo que está pasando ahora mismo?

fr.L: Hypocrites ! Vous savez discerner l’aspect de la terre et du ciel ; mais ce temps-ci, comment ne savez-vous pas le discerner ?
fr.B: Hypocrites ! Vous savez lire l’aspect de la terre et du ciel. Comment se fait-il alors que vous ne sachiez pas lire ce que signifie le moment présent ?
fr.R: Vous faites semblant ! Vous savez regarder la terre et le ciel et dire quel temps il va faire. Alors pourquoi ne comprenez-vous pas ce qui se passe maintenant, en ce moment ?

sw.L: Wanafiki! Sura ya nchi na ya anga mnajua kuipima, lakini wakati huu, mbona hamjui kuupima?
sw.B: Enyi wanafiki! Mnaweza kusoma sura ya nchi na ya anga. Inakuwaje basi hamwezi kusoma maana ya wakati huu?
sw.R: Mnajifanya tu! Mnaweza kutazama nchi na anga mkajua hali ya hewa itakavyokuwa. Basi kwa nini hamuelewi kinachotokea sasa, wakati huu?

vi.L: Hỡi những kẻ đạo đức giả! Các người biết phân biệt sắc diện của đất và trời, nhưng sao thời điểm này các người lại không biết phân biệt?
vi.B: Hỡi những kẻ đạo đức giả! Các người biết đọc dấu hiệu của đất và trời, vậy sao các người không biết đọc ý nghĩa của thời điểm này?
vi.R: Các người chỉ giả vờ thôi! Các người nhìn đất và trời thì biết thời tiết sẽ ra sao. Vậy sao các người lại không hiểu những gì đang xảy ra ngay bây giờ?

ko.L: 위선자들아! 너희는 땅과 하늘의 모양은 분별할 줄 알면서, 어찌하여 이때는 분별할 줄 모르느냐?
ko.B: 위선자들아! 너희는 땅과 하늘의 낯빛은 분별할 줄 알면서, 어찌하여 지금 이때가 무슨 때인지는 분별하지 못하느냐?
ko.R: 너희는 모르는 척하고 있다! 너희는 땅과 하늘을 보고 날씨를 알 줄 안다. 그런데 왜 지금 이때에 일어나고 있는 일은 깨닫지 못하느냐?

decisions.choice: hypocrites: people playing a part, here people who pretend they cannot see
alternatives: people who are insincere in everything
decisions.reason: The word is the one of 12:1. They read the weather well enough; their failure to read the time is not a lack of skill but an unwillingness to see.

decisions.choice: time: the moment God has set, the time of his coming in Jesus
decisions.reason: The word means a fitting or decisive time. Jesus' coming is God's time to visit his people (19:44).

decisions.choice: discern: test and judge, read the signs
decisions.reason: The verb is used of testing metals and so of judging what something is.

decisions.choice: You are pretending!
decisions.reason: Readable says what the word means here, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: read
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the everyday verb for reading the weather and the times.

decisions.choice: este momento (B)
decisions.reason: The moment God has set, the time of his coming in Jesus (meaning decision m2). In a saying about the weather, Spanish "tiempo" would also read as "weather", so Balanced says "momento"; Literal keeps "tiempo", the plain word for the Greek, and Readable says "ahora mismo".

decisions.choice: wanafiki (L, B); Mnajifanya tu! (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide word for people playing a part (meaning decision m1). Readable says "you are only pretending", as the English Readable says "You are pretending!".

decisions.choice: "những kẻ đạo đức giả" (L, B); "Các người chỉ giả vờ thôi!" (R)
decisions.reason: The Gospels' settled word; here they are people who pretend they cannot see (meaning decision), which Readable says.

decisions.choice: "위선자" (L, B), "모르는 척하다" (R); "이때" for kairos
decisions.reason: "위선자" as settled for the Korean Matthew; the meaning decision reads it here as people who pretend they cannot see.

source.text: Τί δὲ καὶ ἀφ’ ἑαυτῶν οὐ κρίνετε τὸ δίκαιον;

records.literal_gloss: Why now even from yourselves not do you judge what [is] right?

en.L: And why do you not, even on your own, judge what is right?
en.B: Why can you not decide for yourselves what is right?
en.R: You should be able to decide for yourselves what is right to do.

es.L: ¿Y por qué no {{plural_you:juzgan|juzgáis}} lo justo aun por {{plural_you:su propia cuenta|vuestra propia cuenta}}?
es.B: ¿Por qué no {{plural_you:son capaces|sois capaces}} de decidir por {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}} qué es lo justo?
es.R: {{plural_you:Deberían|Deberíais}} poder decidir por {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}} qué es lo justo.

fr.L: Et pourquoi ne jugez-vous pas aussi par vous-mêmes de ce qui est juste ?
fr.B: Pourquoi ne pouvez-vous pas décider par vous-mêmes de ce qui est juste ?
fr.R: Vous devriez être capables de décider vous-mêmes ce qu’il est juste de faire.

sw.L: Na kwa nini hata ninyi wenyewe hamwamui lililo haki?
sw.B: Kwa nini hamwezi kuamua wenyewe lililo sawa?
sw.R: Mnapaswa kuweza kuamua wenyewe lililo sawa kufanya.

vi.L: Và sao chính các người không tự mình phán đoán điều gì là đúng?
vi.B: Sao các người không tự quyết định điều gì là đúng?
vi.R: Lẽ ra các người phải tự biết điều gì là đúng mà làm.

ko.L: 그리고 어찌하여 너희는 스스로 옳은 것을 판단하지 않느냐?
ko.B: 어찌하여 너희는 무엇이 옳은지 스스로 판단하지 못하느냐?
ko.R: 너희는 무엇이 옳은 일인지 스스로 판단할 수 있어야 한다.

decisions.choice: right: just, what ought to be done
decisions.reason: The word is the adjective "righteous", here meaning what is just and fitting in this situation. The next verses show what is right: to settle with one's opponent before it is too late.

decisions.choice: even for yourselves: without waiting to be told
decisions.reason: They should see what the time calls for without needing signs from others (11:29).

decisions.choice: a statement instead of a question
decisions.reason: Readable gives the point of the question.

source.text: ὡς γὰρ ὑπάγεις μετὰ τοῦ ἀντιδίκου σου ἐπ’ ἄρχοντα, ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ δὸς ἐργασίαν ἀπηλλάχθαι ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ, μήποτε κατασύρῃ σε πρὸς τὸν κριτήν, καὶ ὁ κριτής σε παραδώσει τῷ πράκτορι, καὶ ὁ πράκτωρ σε βαλεῖ εἰς φυλακήν.

records.literal_gloss: As for you are going with the adversary of you before a ruler, on the way give effort to be released from him, lest he drag you to the judge, and the judge you will hand over to the officer, and the officer you will throw into prison.

en.L: For as you are going with your opponent before a magistrate, make an effort on the way to be set free from {{gender:them|him}}, so that {{gender:they|he}} do not drag you to the judge, and the judge hand you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.
en.B: When someone is taking you to court before the magistrate, do your best to settle with {{gender:them|him}} while you are still on the way. If you do not, your accuser may drag you before the judge. The judge may hand you over to the officer, and the officer may throw you into prison.
en.R: Suppose someone is taking you to court. While you are on the way there, do all you can to settle the matter with that person. If you do not, that person may drag you in front of the judge. The judge may give you to the officer, and the officer will put you in prison.

es.L: Pues mientras vas con tu adversario ante un magistrado, esfuérzate en el camino por quedar libre de {{gender:esa persona|él}}, no sea que te lleve a rastras ante el juez, y el juez te entregue al oficial, y el oficial te eche en prisión.
es.B: Si alguien te lleva a juicio ante el magistrado, haz todo lo posible por llegar a un acuerdo con {{gender:esa persona|él}} mientras aún estás de camino. Si no, tu acusador podría llevarte a rastras ante el juez; el juez podría entregarte al oficial, y el oficial podría meterte en la cárcel.
es.R: Imagina que alguien te lleva a juicio. Mientras todavía estás de camino, haz todo lo que puedas para arreglar el asunto con esa persona. Si no lo haces, esa persona puede llevarte a rastras delante del juez. El juez puede entregarte al oficial, y el oficial te meterá en la cárcel.

fr.L: Car lorsque tu vas avec ton adversaire devant un magistrat, efforce-toi en chemin d’être libéré de lui, de peur qu’il ne te traîne devant le juge, que le juge ne te livre à l’huissier et que l’huissier ne te jette en prison.
fr.B: Quand quelqu’un te conduit au tribunal devant le magistrat, fais tout pour t’arranger avec lui pendant que vous êtes encore en chemin. Sinon, ton accusateur risque de te traîner devant le juge. Le juge pourrait te livrer à l’huissier, et l’huissier te jeter en prison.
fr.R: Imagine que quelqu’un t’emmène au tribunal. Pendant que vous êtes en chemin, fais tout ce que tu peux pour régler l’affaire avec cette personne. Sinon, elle risque de te traîner devant le juge. Le juge te remettra au garde, et le garde te mettra en prison.

sw.L: Kwa maana unapokwenda pamoja na mpinzani wako mbele ya mtawala, ukiwa njiani jitahidi kuachiliwa naye, asije akakukokota mpaka kwa mwamuzi, na mwamuzi akakukabidhi kwa afisa, na afisa akakutupa gerezani.
sw.B: Mtu anapokupeleka mahakamani mbele ya hakimu, fanya bidii mpatane mngali njiani. Usipofanya hivyo, mshtaki wako anaweza kukukokota mbele ya mwamuzi. Mwamuzi anaweza kukukabidhi kwa afisa, na afisa akakutia gerezani.
sw.R: Tuseme mtu anakupeleka mahakamani. Mkiwa njiani kwenda huko, fanya kila uwezalo kumaliza jambo hilo na mtu huyo. Usipofanya hivyo, mtu huyo anaweza kukukokota mbele ya mwamuzi. Mwamuzi anaweza kukukabidhi kwa afisa, naye afisa atakutia gerezani.

vi.L: Vì khi anh cùng đối phương đi đến trước quan tòa, dọc đường hãy cố gắng thoát khỏi [vụ kiện với] người ấy, kẻo người ấy lôi anh đến thẩm phán, rồi thẩm phán giao anh cho viên chức tòa án, và viên chức tòa án ném anh vào ngục.
vi.B: Khi có người kiện anh ra trước quan tòa, hãy cố hết sức dàn xếp với người ấy khi còn đang đi đường. Nếu không, người kiện anh có thể lôi anh đến trước thẩm phán. Thẩm phán có thể giao anh cho viên chức tòa án, và viên chức ấy có thể bỏ anh vào tù.
vi.R: Giả sử có người kiện anh ra tòa. Khi đang trên đường đến đó, hãy làm mọi cách để giải quyết xong việc với người ấy. Nếu không, người ấy có thể lôi anh đến trước thẩm phán. Thẩm phán có thể giao anh cho viên chức tòa án, và viên chức ấy sẽ bỏ anh vào tù.

ko.L: 네가 너를 고소하는 사람과 함께 관원에게 갈 때에, 길에서 그에게서 풀려나도록 힘써라. 그가 너를 재판관에게 끌고 가고, 재판관이 너를 집행관에게 넘겨주고, 집행관이 너를 감옥에 던져 넣는 일이 없도록 하여라.
ko.B: 누가 너를 고소하여 관원에게 데려가거든, 아직 길에 있을 때에 그 사람과 화해하도록 힘써라. 그렇지 않으면 그 사람이 너를 재판관에게 끌고 갈 것이다. 재판관은 너를 집행관에게 넘기고, 집행관은 너를 감옥에 가둘 것이다.
ko.R: 누가 너를 고소해서 재판을 받으러 간다고 하자. 그러면 법정에 가는 길에 그 사람과 문제를 해결하려고 힘써라. 그렇게 하지 않으면 그 사람이 너를 재판관 앞으로 끌고 갈 것이다. 재판관은 너를 법정 관리에게 넘길 것이고, 그 관리는 너를 감옥에 가둘 것이다.

decisions.choice: opponent: someone suing you, probably over a debt; officer: the court official who collected debts
decisions.reason: The word for the opponent is a legal one. The officer was the one who carried out the court's ruling and could hold a debtor in prison until the debt was paid (12:59; Matthew 5:25-26).

decisions.choice: settle on the way: a picture of the need to make peace with God before the judgment
decisions.reason: After 12:54-57 the saying is more than advice about courts. Those who read the time should put things right with God while there is still time.

decisions.choice: make an effort to be set free from him: try hard to settle the case
decisions.reason: The phrase means to work at being released from the claim, by coming to terms with the accuser.

decisions.choice: {{gender:them|him}}
decisions.reason: The opponent may be a man or a woman; the inclusive form is the default, as in Matthew 5:25.

decisions.choice: settle the matter with that person
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom.

decisions.choice: the situation first, then the advice
alternatives: As you are going with your opponent ...
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable set out the case before saying what to do, as Matthew 5:25 does.

decisions.choice: tú, with no plural_you span
decisions.reason: The Greek turns here from the plural to the singular, one person on the way to court (meaning decision m1). Spanish shows it with "tú", which has no setting, as the English cannot.
Jesus turns from the crowd to a single hearer in the Greek ("you are going", "your opponent" are singular), and French follows the Greek number (style guide §6).

decisions.choice: "ton adversaire … lui", "quelqu’un … lui", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Adversaire" and "quelqu’un" can be a man or a woman, and the pronouns that refer back to them are ordinary generic French, as in 12:8.

decisions.choice: "viên chức tòa án" for the officer
decisions.reason: The officer was the court official who collected debts (meaning decision); "viên chức tòa án" names his place without guessing at a modern office.

decisions.choice: "너" for the singular "you" in 12:58-59; "집행관" (L, B), "법정 관리" (R) for praktōr; "그 사람" with no gender span
alternatives: "형리", as for a different word in Matthew 5:25
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the officer as the court official who collected debts.

source.text: λέγω σοι, οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃς ἐκεῖθεν ἕως καὶ τὸ ἔσχατον λεπτὸν ἀποδῷς.

records.literal_gloss: I say to you, not not you will come out from there until even the last lepton you have paid.

en.L: I tell you, you will never get out of there until you have paid even the last lepton."
en.B: I tell you, there will be no way out for you until {{units:the very last penny|the very last lepton}} is paid."
en.R: I tell you, you will not get out of prison until you have paid {{units:every last cent|every last lepton}}."

es.L: Te digo: de ningún modo saldrás de allí hasta que pagues incluso el último leptón».
es.B: Te digo que no habrá salida para ti hasta que se haya pagado {{units:el último centavo|el último leptón}}».
es.R: Te digo que no saldrás de la cárcel hasta que hayas pagado {{units:hasta el último centavo|hasta el último leptón}}».

fr.L: Je te dis : tu ne sortiras jamais de là tant que tu n’auras pas payé même le dernier lepte. »
fr.B: Je te le dis, tu n’auras aucun moyen d’en sortir tant que tu n’auras pas payé {{units:le tout dernier centime|le tout dernier lepte}}. »
fr.R: Je te le dis, tu ne sortiras pas de prison avant d’avoir payé {{units:jusqu’au dernier centime|jusqu’au dernier lepte}}. »

ko.L: 내가 너에게 말한다. 네가 마지막 한 렙돈까지 갚기 전에는 결코 거기서 나오지 못할 것이다."
ko.B: 내가 너에게 말한다. 네가 {{units:마지막 한 푼까지|마지막 한 렙돈까지}} 다 갚기 전에는 결코 거기서 나오지 못할 것이다."
ko.R: 내가 너에게 말한다. 너는 {{units:마지막 동전 한 닢까지|마지막 한 렙돈까지}} 다 갚아야 감옥에서 나올 수 있을 것이다."

decisions.choice: lepton: the smallest coin in use
decisions.reason: A lepton was a tiny copper coin worth half a quadrans (Mark 12:42), a hundred and twenty-eighth of a denarius, the day's wage of a laborer. The widow put two of them into the temple treasury (21:2). The debt must be paid to the last coin.

decisions.choice: never: a strong double negative
decisions.reason: The Greek uses two negatives together for an emphatic denial.

decisions.choice: {{units:the very last penny|the very last lepton}} (B); {{units:every last cent|every last lepton}} (R)
alternatives: the last lepton at every level
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the modern smallest coin by default, with the original coin as the alternative, as Matthew 5:26 does. Literal keeps the original coin.

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here
decisions.reason: The speech that began in 12:54 ends with the chapter.

decisions.choice: el último leptón (L); {{units:el último centavo|el último leptón}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The lepton was the smallest coin in use (meaning decision m1). As in Matthew 5:26, "centavo" says "the very smallest coin" as the English "penny" and "cent" do; Literal and the alternative keep the coin's name, "leptón".

decisions.choice: {{units:le tout dernier centime|le tout dernier lepte}} (B); {{units:jusqu’au dernier centime|jusqu’au dernier lepte}} (R); le dernier lepte (L)
decisions.reason: As in 12:6: the euro cent is the modern smallest coin for French readers, where English has penny and cent; "lepte" is the French name of the Greek coin, as in Mark 12:42.

decisions.choice: leptoni ya mwisho (L); {{units:senti ya mwisho|leptoni ya mwisho}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The lepton was the smallest coin in use (meaning decision m1). As in Matthew 5:26, "senti" is the smallest coin Swahili readers know; Literal and the alternative keep the coin's name, given here as "leptoni". A reviewer should confirm the Swahili form of the coin's name.

decisions.choice: "đồng lép-ton" (L, and the alternative in B, R); "đồng xu nhỏ nhất" as the B, R default
decisions.reason: The lepton was the smallest coin (meaning decision). Literal keeps the coin name, in the singular of the "lép-ta" of Mark 12:42; Balanced and Readable say what it was by default.

decisions.choice: {{units:마지막 한 푼까지|마지막 한 렙돈까지}} (B); {{units:마지막 동전 한 닢까지|마지막 한 렙돈까지}} (R); "렙돈" (L)
decisions.reason: As the Korean Matthew 5:26 does with the quadrans; "렙돈" as in the Korean Mark 12:42.
